162381.overview:
Saint & Sinner is a puzzle game, developed  by CyberPlanet Interactive and published by Phoenix Games, which was released in Europe in 2006.
When the good thought and evils thought are met, the ultimate battle occurs. Saint & Sinner is a strategic puzzle game similar to Othello. You have to conquer the various evils in your mind. The higher level you reach, the more good thoughts you must get!!

162531.overview: NRL Rugby League is a New Zealand-developed rugby sports game in the tradition of console based sports titles. It features 30 licensed teams, several major leagues and interantional test matches, 25 realistic stadiums, commentary by Andrew Voss, variable weather conditions, and all the action on the field you would expect from a game based on the sport, including advanced moves such as offloads, fend offs, side steps and dummy passes. You can create your own players, teams and competitions, with detailed statistics, and you have to take injuries, sin bins and send offs into account.

162845.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 94: The Aka-Champion: Come On Baby is a 2005 release for PS2 from D3 Publisher and developer Expotato. It's the home version of their 2000 arcade game.

Come on Baby is a sports game with a difference, all the competitors are babies. Players select their character and compete in many different events. Events include dancing, driving, sumo wrestling, running races, water races and more.

163322.overview:
Seaman 2: Pekin Genjin Ikusei Kit is a direct sequel to the original Seaman. It is a take on the god game genre that places you in charge of a Peking 'Seaman' named Gabo, manipulating the environment to feed and take care of him.

The game features a voice detection system that allows the players to issue commands and talk with the Seaman via the special "Seamic Controller", a controller with a built-in microphone which was previously bundled with the PlayStation 2 port of the first Seaman game and was reissued for Seaman 2. Two versions of Seaman 2 were released: one which includes a Seamic Controller and one which does not.

163606.overview:
In the school, the three people met. 

Their relation had been changed in the season, and turned into three love stories. Makoto has been admiring a girl he has seen on the train. That girl is Kotonoha Katsura, and he even managed to take a photo of her with his cell phone. Due to new seating in his class, he ends up next to Sekai Saionji, a nosy, but sweet and sincere girl. As she snoops for his cell phone while talking to him, she discovers his crush and vows to help him until Kotonoha agrees to go out with him. 

When Sekai finally gets them together, she realizes her own feelings after finding out that the person Kotonoha liked was, in fact, Makoto. While waiting for her train next to Makoto, who was waiting for Kotonoha, she has him talking about how he can repay her for all of her help. Before leaving for her train, she kisses him and cries when she boards the way home. Kotonoha happily arrives for her date with Makoto shortly after. 

With all three main characters carrying different expressions on their faces, the story begins.

164320.overview:
Sega Ages 2500 Series Vol. 25: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box (SEGA AGES 2500シリーズ Vol.25 ガンスターヒーローズ ～トレジャーボックス～) is the twenty-fifth entry in the Sega Ages 2500 series for the PlayStation 2.

This game is a compilation, containing three titles by Treasure. Everything is emulated, with several additional options to tweak the emulation process, though the sound is slightly inaccurate. There are extensive galleries for all three games and overseas versions to play. More interestingly, a hidden prototype version of Gunstar Heroes exists.

It was later rereleased on the PlayStation 3's PlayStation Network as a digital download as Gunstar Heroes: Treasure Box. As this entry was released with the older CERO rating system, the re-release was re-rated A.

Gunstar Heroes (Sega Mega Drive)
Dynamite Headdy (Sega Mega Drive)
Alien Soldier (Sega Mega Drive)
Gunstar Heroes Prototype (Sega Mega Drive)
Gunstar Heroes (Sega Game Gear)
Dynamite Headdy (Sega Game Gear)
Dynamite Headdy (Sega Master System)

164321.overview:
Sega Ages 2500 Series Vol. 33: Fantasy Zone Complete Collection (SEGA AGES 2500シリーズ Vol.33 ファンタジーゾーン コンプリートコレクション) is the thirty-third and final entry in the Sega Ages 2500 series for the PlayStation 2.

This game contains every game released in the Fantasy Zone series (bar the redemption game), plus several "new" ones. The games are emulated, though there are handful of extra options to "improve" many of them.

Also included is Fantasy Zone Neo Classic which is an updated port of the Famicom version of Fantasy Zone, and Fantasy Zone II DX - a remastered version of Fantasy Zone II to look and feel as if it were running on Sega System 16 hardware.

The collection also includes development material for Fantasy Zone II, assorted other concept art, cover art masters, full cover/manual scans for the included games's Japanese, US, and European releases, and full flyer scans for the Japanese and English releases of the arcade games (including the redemption game).

Opa Opa (Sega Master System)
Galactic Protector (Sega Master System)
Fantasy Zone Neo Classic

164630.overview:
Sega Rally 2006 is an rally racing game featuring a career, arcade, and a time attack mode.

In the main career mode, players follow a daily schedule, with some days set aside for preparing their car or practicing for an upcoming event. Players select from a plethora of cars whose performance can be improved by spending earned prize money on them. The arcade mode features timed checkpoint racing against 14 other cars, while the time attack mode lets the player try to finish a race as fast as possible.

The game also came packaged with the bonus disc Sega Rally Championship 1995.

166046.overview:
Capcom Co., Ltd. is a 3D fighting game for the PlayStation 2 based on the popular manga "The History's Strongest Disciple Kenichi", which is serialized in Weekly Shonen Sunday, "The Strongest Disciple History's Disciple Kenichi Fights! Ragnalek 8 Fist" It will be released on March 15. The price is 7,140 yen. As a first-come-first-go purchase bonus, "With DVD! The strongest calendar ever" is included. Distribution ends as soon as the benefits are gone.

　“The strongest disciple Kenichi in history! Ragnalek 8 Kengo” is a bullied child high school student “Shirahama Kenichi” admired in the fighting girl “Kurinji Mio” who has been converted, and martial arts masters gather A story that grows little by little through battles with strong opponents, such as a bad group “Ragnalek” of a martial arts corps, while continuing training at Dojo “Ryan Yamabori”.

166071.overview:
Samurai Spirits Tenkaichi Kenkakuden is a dream match game which features the entire cast from Samurai Shodown V Special, seven returning characters from Samurai Shodown and Samurai Shodown II, and several new characters added to the Playstation 2 port of the game.

The story is parallel to Samurai Shodown V; Yoshitora decides to find out who the strongest fighter in the world is, so a tournament is then organized with this purpose.

The game is similar to the Samurai Shodown V Special; however, the player is now capable of using one of six different fighting systems, all of which have their own advantages and disadvantages. Items like bombs and rocks can also be picked up and thrown at the enemy.

The game also contains an extensive move list for every character, original and arranged music, and two player versus mode via netplay.

168184.overview: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Girlfriend of Steel 2nd is a Gainax-produced adventure anime-style video game, and manga based on that game, set in the alternate universe seen in episode 26 of Neon Genesis Evangelion. The player controls Shinji Ikari, the hero of the original Evangelion series, as he navigates his home, school, and social life in a now-peaceful "Tokyo-3".

174185.overview: SX superstar is a motocross racing game. In arcade mode, you can pick a rider, bike, and track, and have a quick race against the AI riders. In championship mode you start as a poor, amateur rider, and you try to work your way up to motocross stardom. You have to manage your finances, get sponsorships, and buy better bikes in order to beat your opponents. You have to do well in a variety of races including arenas, bajas, and A2Bs, in order to get promoted to higher leagues.

174188.overview: In Springdale the player takes control of a young girl who get to enter the horse riding world of Springdale and ride many different types of horses. In addition to riding the horses the player gets to work in the stable where she learns about how they should be taken care of.

174276.overview:
SingStar Deutsch Rock-Pop is a karaoke game, featuring popular German hit songs. The game gives points which are distributed by the purity of singing, as in how well does one manage to stay on tune. It does not matter if you change octaves in the middle of the song or what words are you singing in as it does not have word recognition, so your singing is rated by how well you manage to hit the correct note at the correct time.

174279.overview:
SingStar THE DOME: With this new compilation - a mixture of 30 international and national tracks - all THE DOME fans can now bring the mega-star chart party into their living room. The top-class line-up ranges from chart breakers like "Let Me Entertain You" from Robbie Williams to classics like "Born to be Wild" from Steppenwolf. Every party is guaranteed to be a hit!
As soon as the PlayStation 2 microphones are connected and the voice is oiled, you can start singing. If you want to sing yourself warm first, you can do this in single player mode. The brave among aspiring SingStars can challenge friends and family in party mode. Whether in battle mode, in which two players sing at the same time but against each other, or in duet mode, in which two players do their best together and the score is accumulated - the audience will be thrilled. If you are afraid of the incorruptible virtual jury, you can kick off in freestyle mode without being rated.
 

The new medley feature in SingStar THE DOME mixes the best parts of multiple songs into one song. The songs of the Heartache Medley entice you with lovesickness or romantic hours for two. The Random Medley demands spontaneity.
 

With the HipHop bonus feature, players can show off their rap skills to earn extra points.

176325.overview:
Votoms is an action game based on the '80s anime series of the same name. The player assumes the role of Chirico Cuvie and fights using mecha known as "Armored Troopers."

The game also covers the entire original TV series narrative as well as its multitudinous OVA-based progeny (bar Mellowlink, though there are a few missions on Sunsa that have you take out ATs just on foot, which was a nice nod). You even get a Blue Knight side-story mission, which is incredible considering how niche the original manga was.

There’s so much this game gets right, from how the ATs handle, to hitting the beats of the original anime’s narrative. The only real downside to the whole thing is that the environments can be quite spartan and simplistic. They’re also overused in some sections. Obviously, the priority was to model all the various ATs and other enemies you face. So the heavy task of creating richer and more involved environments fell by the wayside.

Overall, even if you know nothing about VOTOMS, let alone mecha gaming, you’ll appreciate the wonderful job Yuke’s have done of creating a consistent handling ruleset for the ATs in this game. The sheer visceral thrill of speeding through a dangerous troupe of equally lethal enemy ATs whilst literally dancing around them is quite wonderful indeed.

176327.overview: The science fiction series is a homage to the Super Robot shows of the 1970s and 1980s, executed with modern animation techniques and aesthetics. Set in the future, a giant fighting machine called the Aquarion is humanity's only effective weapon in the fight against the technologically advanced species called the Shadow Angels.

177300.overview:
Prepare your paddle for brick-breaking RPG action!

7 Dooms exist in this world, with legendary monsters waiting for your challenge! Turn your system on its side and operate the dragon paddle to fight through 120 challenging stages of brick-breaking action. Earn experience points and increase the strength and spell powers of your paddle as you take on a totally unique gaming experience mixing classic brick-breaking gameplay with RPG elements.

• A unique mix of RPG and brick-breaking gameplay played vertically on your system
• Destroy all the blocs on each stage to progress and clear the land of evil
• Earn experience points and level up as you clear each stage
• Use special moves like squash hits, shake-the-wall and plasma cannon
• Battle powerful boss enemies at the end of each zone
• Fight against your friends via wireless play

177406.overview:
Trizeal is a Japanese shoot 'em up arcade game developed by Triangle Service.

Players control and can transform a spaceship into three forms (which alternates weapon attacks), working through multiple levels and boss sequences. The game can be played in four different screen modes, with one mode mimicking the narrow arcade version. A ship from Triangle Service's previous release, XII Stag, is hidden in the game and can be unlocked by holding the "X" button before selecting a stage in Stage Attack mode. The power-ups can be used to upgrade each separate weapon respectively.

There are 6 levels in the game, they get progressively harder until the last stage which consists of only two bosses. Two unlockable modes become available when the game is completed, they are Omake mode and Lifting mode. Omake mode is a short level which has denser bullet patterns than the normal game, lifting mode is where you have to juggle a stone on your ship to score points.

178653.overview: Shinkon Gattai Godannar is a 3D fighting game, based on the popular anime of the same name. In the game you use the gigantic robots named mimetic beasts to battle the opponents. During the battle, you can pick up different kinds of objects on the field as weapon, such as trucks on the road.

178654.overview: Slot! Pro DX: Fujiko 2 is a Pachinko game, published by Nippon Telenet, which was released in Japan in 2003

178658.overview: Slotter Up Core 5 is a Pachinko game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004

178811.overview: Saiyuki Reload Gunlock was released in Japan on August 5, 2004, by Bandai for the PlayStation 2. This fighting game features a total of eight playable characters including Sanzo, Goku, Gojyo and Hakkai as well as Kougaiji, Chin Yisou, Kamisama, and Hazel. Playable game modes include traditional single and multiplayer modes, as well as Practice Mode, Watch Mode, and a story-akin Dramatic Mode

178855.overview:
In the third installment of the Sakura Taisen series, Ichiro Ogami goes to Paris, to command the pretty girls of Paris Kagekidan (Flower Assault Squad), led by the lovely Erica. Just as in Japan, this special unit has a complex base which is disguised as a theater, since the girls of Paris Kagekidan can can act on stage as well as pilot huge steam-powered mechs. An unknown evil is threatening the city, so it's time for Ichiro to take command and save Paris from the demonic threat.
Sakura Wars 3 retains the basic gameplay style of the series, being a hybrid of dating-oriented role-playing (with timed responses during conversations with the girls, and the possibility to conquer the heart of one of them), and strategic turn-based battles. The game features fully 3D graphics for the battles and the map of Paris (although the locations in adventure mode are still 2D still images). 
The interface for the battles has been modified: you can move your mechs physically on the battle field instead of pointing and clicking, and an action points-based system replaces the "two different commands per turn" style of the first two games.

178858.overview:
Sakura Taisen Monogatari: Mysterious Paris takes place in Paris of the 1920's, sharing the story arc and featuring characters from Sakura Taisen 3.

In this game, the player takes control over Kojirou Akechi, a detective from Japan. His sister Miki is a dancer at Paris Kagekidan, the same organization featured in Sakura Taisen 3. Kojirou comes from Japan to Paris to see Miki performing as a front-row dancer for the first time at "Les Chattes Noires". However, upon arriving he finds out Miki's roommate Elza has disappeared. Kojirou will have to solve the mystery, that will lead him to secret dark societies that are flourishing in Paris.

Unlike the previous Sakura Taisen games, Mysterious Paris is a pure Japanese-style adventure, without any battles. The game progresses as a detective investigation, which involves talking to suspects, gathering clues, etc. In the end the player receives a title, depending on his/her PI skills. Interaction with the characters is performed using the same time-limit system as the previous two games: the player has to choose a response quickly, since silence is also considered response.

178860.overview:
Sakura Taisen V Episode 0: Samurai Girl of Wild (サクラ大戦V EPISODE 0〜荒野のサムライ娘〜) is a side-story in the Sakura Wars series, and an introduction chapter to Sakura Wars: So Long, My Love. It features different setting, characters, and gameplay style compared to the first four Sakura Wars titles.
The story is set in America, and focuses on one of the new cast members of the upcoming fifth installment, a young Japanese-American girl named Gemini Sunrise. She has spent her childhood in Texas, but is now sent to New York. The Samurai Cowgirl boards her trusty friend, the horse Rodeo, and heads for the "Big Apple", to meet many new characters and to experience many adventures.
The game is a radical departure from Sakura Wars style, gameplay-wise. This is primarily an action game, where Gemini fights her enemies in real-time, on a horseback, in what is called "Action Rodeo Combat". The dialogues are still built according to the classical Sakura Wars model, featuring multiple choices by dialogues which lead to different relationships between characters.

178862.overview: Sakura Wars: In Hot Blood (サクラ大戦 〜熱き血潮に〜) is a remake of the first Sakura Wars. The game's story and core gameplay remain unchanged from the original version. New in the remake are additional CG movies, several new characters and scenarios, battle system updated to the Dreamcast Sakura Wars games, and the LIPS system: pressing the analog stick on the controller determines the emotional strength of your answer. Dialogue choices now have a time limit.

178864.overview:
Scandal is an interactive anime movie, much like Triangle Again games, which puts you in a role of a freelance photographer, Saki Kitazawa. While your father was a professional in the same line of work, you go on a day-by-day basis with whatever job comes your way. This time, it includes a famous rock musician. All enthusiastic about your next gig, you were glad to enter the prestigious private part under a guise to look for your next scoop. But what you didn't know is that your next photo is going to change your life and put you in a dangerous turmoil of murder and mystery.

The game moves one video scene at the time, where you can progress as in visual novels, by clicking the button after each event, or leave it in auto mode so it moves like an anime movie. You can select a difference choice in certain dialogues which will move the conversation one way or another, although some of the answers will have to be selected quickly within a time limit for your reaction.

178865.overview: Secret of Evangelion is an investigative adventure game in the Shinseiki Evangelion universe. Players control of take NERV intelligence agent Kenzaki Kyouya as he unravels mysteries and flirts with Dummy Plug pilots.

178866.overview: The game takes place in the Sekirei timeline, being played as a visual novel. Minato and the Sekirei in Izumo Inn encounter new characters consisting of Sekirei No. 54, Kuruse, Sekirei No. 57, Yahan, Ashikabi Reiji Koya and a baby referred to as Aka-chan. It centers around the discovery of the said baby, who is being pursued by unknown persons after Minato and the Sekirei found her abandoned in the city.

178867.overview: Shinseiki Evangelion 2 is an Evangelion-based RPG video game, released in 2003 for PlayStation 2, and later a PSP version was released in 2006. It allows the player to follow several characters through several different versions of the plot of the series. The game itself is a combination of an RPG, a raising game, and a dating sim rolled into one. Hideaki Anno was heavily interviewed for the Classified Information files, and is also credited for the Events engine in the game.

178868.overview: Shinseiki GPX Cyber Formula: Road to the Infinity is a Racing game, developed by Atelier-Sai and published by Sunrise Interactive, which was released in Japan in 2003.

178869.overview: Shirachuu Tankenbu is an Adventure game, developed by Nex Entertainment and published by Taito Corporation, which was released in Japan in 2003.

179697.overview:
Sengoku Basara is a Hack and Slash video game published by Capcom released on July 21, 2005 for the Sony PlayStation 2.

Not to be Confused with the Localized Abomination, Devil Kings, Sengoku Basara is a Hack n’ Slash in the same Style as Dynasty Warriors but using Japanese Warlords and Generals during the Sengoku era. The Plot is pretty simple with Each General/Warlord wanting to Conquer Japan for Their Side/Themselves. The Characters themselves are exaggerated Versions of their normal Historically counter Parts. (Example: Nobunaga basically being Evil Incarnate with Demonic Powers.) Unlike the Localization, The Game Sports 16 Playable Characters with Different abilities and Fighting Styles.

All and All if you like Dynasty Warrior Style games then you’ll like this and if you’re desperate to play this in English then you are welcome to play the Mentioned Devil Kings, but Overall Sengoku Basara offers more play value even if you can’t really understand whats going on.

179699.overview:
戦国BASARA2 Sengoku BASARA 2 is the sequel to the first Sengoku BASARA game first released by Capcom for the PlayStation 2 on 27 July 2006. When its expansion game Sengoku BASARA 2 Heroes was released for PlayStation 2 and Wii in 2007, the Wii version is packed with the version port of this game.

 Sengoku Drive

Upon getting 100 kills, the player gains one level of the Sengoku Drive is added to stock (max. 3; though current capacity is dependent of character level). When there is at least 1 level of the Sengoku Drive, the character can enter the drive state. While in that state, the character glows yellow (redder if a higher level of drive) and his/her attack and (with the exception of Nōhime's) attack speed increases. However, attack speed of skills are not affected. The character also cannot be staggered (except by a Basara attack) and cannot be KO'ed (at least 1 point of life will remain after and during enemy comboes). Activating Sengoku Drive at higher levels makes the character stay in that state longer.

It should be noted however, that the AI characters can also enter this state. Rather than having to defeat 100 enemies, a bar will fill up whenever that character is attacked by the player (the rate depends on the difficulty) and will start to gradually fill up after taking enough damage, and will enter level 1 drive state when it is full. The AI gains all effects of the drive state except not being KO'ed.

Basara Fever

Everytime the player performs 500 hits in a combo, he/she triggers Basara Fever. When this occurs, the player is awarded an item box and the character enters level 1 drive state. This drive does not use up the Sengoku Drive in stock. Basara Fever is also part of getting some title fans.

179701.overview:
戦国BASARA2英雄外伝 Sengoku BASARA 2 Heroes (aka. Sengoku Basara 2 Eiyuu Gaiden) is the expansion for Sengoku BASARA 2 released by Capcom for the PlayStation 2 and Wii on 29 November 2007. 

Game Modes

Story Mode
Very much like Sengoku Basara 2's Story Mode, players pick a character and go through his/her story. However, unlike Sengoku Basara 2, the player can only choose among 3 (newly playable) characters. Katakura Kojūrō, Azai Nagamasa and Oichi are the story choices. The player will receive the third costume on the characters.

Gaiden Story Mode
A new mode added in Sengoku Basara 2 Heroes. Gaiden Story Mode plays like Story Mode, but the difference is that it is shorter, comprising of only 3 stages each. The available characters for this mode are also limited. Fūma Kotarō, Maeda Keiji, Date Masamune, Sanada Yukimura, and Chōsokabe Motochika are in the Gaiden. They can also unlock the third costume of the characters.

Conquest Mode
Conquest Mode is still like in Sengoku Basara 2. However, this time, it feature a new (random) battle and can now be played with 2 players. Finishing it will unlock the player's second costume

Free Battle Mode
Like in previous Sengoku Basara game, Free Battle Mode lets player play any unlocked stage as any character. Stages (including exclusive stages) from both Sengoku Basara 2 and Heroes can be played here, provided they are unlocked.

Tournament Mode
Tournament Mode from Sengoku Basara 2 is back, but with a lot of differences. There are now 2 type of tournament: Grand Tournament and Ultimate Grand Tournament. Like Conquest Mode, this mode can also be played with 2 players. Players now choose 2 characters for this mode and play it like a tag battle (if one player) and split-screen coop (if 2 players), making it easier. If a character gets KO'ed, he/she can be revived by the other player if coop or if in single player, the other character takes his/her place and gets revived in the next round. The enemies fought in rounds are also different. The roulette feature that appears after clearing each round is removed. Players are still awarded the best weapon and armor for the characters used by winning 100 and 50 rounds respectively, and can still save every 10 rounds to keep the progress.

Grand Tournament plays very much like Sengoku Basara 2's Tournament Mode. In this tournament, there are challenges which the player/s can do while they are fighting through the tournament, completing them rewards players with gold and a rice ball and completing all 60 of them unlocks a title fan. The EXP gained from clearing the rounds are divided among the 2 characters used.

Ultimate Grand Tournament is mainly the same as Grand Tournament. However, instead of getting EXP for clearing rounds, gold is rewarded. There is also a time limit which refills and accumulates upon clearing each round.

Versus Mode
Another new mode added in this game. Versus Mode puts 2 characters against each other in one of 8 types of competitions.

Super Puzzle Bobble, released as Super Bust-A-Move in Europe and North America, is a puzzle video game in the Puzzle Bobble series. It was re-released in Japan for the PlayStation 2 in 2004 as part of Super Puzzle Bobble DX (along with its sequel, Super Puzzle Bobble 2), which is Volume 62 of the Japan-exclusive Simple 2000 Series. This compilation includes a few graphical enhancements.

Super Puzzle Bobble was ported to the GameCube in 2003, under the name of Super Puzzle Bobble All-Stars in Japan, Super Bust-A-Move All-Stars in Europe and Bust-A-Move 3000 in North America. The game is a direct port, except for the inclusion of new backgrounds and remixed music. It also features new box artwork, more in line with the in-game artwork.

It is the first mainstream game in the series not to see an arcade release, although there is an arcade game with the same title, which is a completely different game to this one.

201102.overview:
Shadow of Memories (シャドウ・オブ・メモリーズ, Shadou obu Memorīzu) (Shadow of Destiny in North America) is a Mystery adventure game developed by Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo and published by Konami. Originally released for the PlayStation 2 in 2001, it was later ported to Xbox (which is only released in Europe) and Microsoft Windows in 2002. A PlayStation Portable version was released on October 1, 2009 in Japan and on January 26, 2010 in North America.

The objective of Shadow of Memories is to guide player character Eike Kusch through the fictional German town of Lebensbaum (Life's Tree) as he travels through time to prevent and unmask his murderer. The game takes place in three parts: a prologue, eight chapters, and an epilogue. In the prologue and each chapter, Eike dies, is resurrected by the non-player character Homunculus, and travels back in time before his death with the intent of changing events to prevent it. Shadow of Memories lacks traditional action elements, and Eike cannot attack nor does he have a bar displaying his health. The digipad, a time-traveling item given to Eike by Homunculus, requires energy units, which the player can find scattered around the town. The gameplay primarily consists of time-traveling through the different eras, finding items, and interacting through dialogue with the non-player characters. 
Actions taken in one time period affect future ones; for example, if Eike removes a seal from the squire's manor in 1580, the seal will not appear in the present era.

Additionally, the game keeps two digital clocks: one depicting the time in the present-day era and another for whichever era Eike time-travels to. The amount of time Eike spends in the different eras also passes in the present-day one. The cut-scenes and dialogue takes up varying amounts of in-game time. When the clock arrives at the time of Eike's death, the chapter restarts, however, if Eike is not in his time period at the time of his death, the game ends.

201196.overview:
Shaman King: Funbari Spirits (Japanese: シャーマンキング ふんばりスピリッツ, is a cel-shaded 2D style fighting game released in Japan only on April 4, 2004. It is not to be confused with Shaman King: Power of Spirit, a game produced by Konami to go along with the 4kids Entertainment dub. It is a pseudo-sequel to Shaman King: Spirit of Shamans, a 2D fighting game for the PlayStation. This game is based upon the Manga. 

Funbari Spirits features simple controls and plays quite like a 2D fighter despite being 3D. There is a 2 player mode, adventure story mode, mini game mode, and a free play mode along with training mode. The game also has voices from the original anime, as well as colorful cel-shaded graphics. All of the main characters are present as playable characters, along with a few exclusive-to-this-game-only characters.

It is a horror adventure game based on the 47 prefectures of Japan. The game is based on actual locations throughout Japan, and you read ghost stories with a rich regional flavor based on the data obtained. Although the game is classified as an ADV, it also contains elements of puzzle and RPG, and the production side has avoided categorizing it into specific genres. Basically, it is a work that uses live action, following the style of "Scary Stories from School" by Takiya Iijima. Some of them use CG, and some of them are audio-only scenarios.

208299.overview: Sidewinder Max is a aircraft simulation game, developed by Bit Town and published by Asmik Ace Entertainment, Inc, which was released in Japan in 2000. An European release, titled Iron Eagle MAX, was planned but eventually cancelled.

208392.overview:
Shinseiki Evangelion: Koutetsu no Girlfriend Tokubetsu-hen (新世紀エヴァンゲリオン 鋼鉄のガールフレンド 特別編) is a Visual Novel video game published by Gainax released on March 30th, 2006 for the PS2.

Fourteen-year-old Mana Kirishima (voiced by Megumi Hayashibara) is transferred to Shinji Ikari's school, and almost immediately they begin to establish a special relationship. This provokes much jealousy in Asuka, who also suspects that Mana is a spy who is trying to get information from Shinji about NERV and the Evas. Rei Ayanami is present but plays a rather background role in the story, though she seems to agree with the suspicions of Asuka. Gradually, a relationship between Mana and Shinji unfolds and they end up going on a date. It turns out, however, that Mana is one of three test pilots for the TRIDENT (alternatively named the "Country Crawler") units, a new competitor to the Evangelions, similar to Jet Alone; thus the name Girlfriend of Steel. Eventually, the TRIDENT goes berserk and the Evas have to destroy it.

The interactivity in most of the game is limited to walking around areas until the next plot event is triggered. However, the one true branch occurs at the end of the game, where the player may choose to focus on Mana, Asuka or Kaji. This choice determines which of the game's three endings are shown, with a fourth exclusive to the PS2.

210871.overview: Shanghai: Four Elements is a Puzzle game, developed and published by SunSoft, which was released in Japan in 2000.

210994.overview: Sagashi ni Ikouyo is a Role-Playing game, published by SCEI, which was released in Japan in 2001.

211538.overview: SD Gundam G Generation Neo is a Strategy game, developed by Tom Create and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 2002.

211540.overview: SD Gundam G Generation Seed is a Strategy game, developed and published by Bandai, which was released in Japan in 2004.

211542.overview: SD Gundam G Generation Spirits is a Strategy game, developed by Tom Create and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2007.

211544.overview: SD Gundam G Generation Wars is a Strategy game, developed by Tom Create and published by Bandai Namco Games, which was released in Japan in 2009.

211546.overview: Shikigami no Shiro: Nanayozuki Gensoukyoku is an Action Adventure game, developed by Alfa System and published by Kids Station, which was released in Japan in 2005.

211556.overview: Shinseiki Yuusha Taisen is a Strategy game, developed by WinkySoft and published by Atlus, which was released in Japan in 2005.

211582.overview: Slotter UP Mania 2 is a gambling game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2003.

The game features a perfect simulation of the 3 pachinko machine Pegasus series (New Olympia Pegasus, New Pegasus A & New Pegasus L) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

211584.overview: Slotter UP Mania 4 is a gambling game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004.

211585.overview:
Slotter Up Mania 5 - Soukaigekida Mach Go Go Go & Daruma Neko is a pachinko simulation, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004.
 The game features a perfect simulation of 2 pachinko Pioneer machines (Mach Go Go Go & Manekineko Plus Daruma) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

211586.overview:
Slotter Up Mania 7 - Saishinsaikyou Pioneer Max is a pachinko simulation, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2005.
 The game features a perfect simulation of 2 pachinko Pioneer machines (Super Sio Sai & Big Siosienne) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

Slotter Up Mania 7 features two machines from pachislot maker Pioneer. The game lets you switch on auto play so that you can collect data over a lengthy period. This is for people who feel that by playing these games they can improve their pachinko skills and translate that into real money at the pachinko parlor.

211587.overview:
Slotter Up Mania 8 - Juggler Special 2 is a pachinko simulation, the game features a perfect simulation of 4 pachinko Pioneer machines (Go Go Juggler V, Go Go Juggler S-30, Juggler Girl & Juggler TM) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

Slotter Up Mania 8 includes four machines from the well-known Juggler line of pachislot machines. The game includes a practice mode which lets you work on your strategy. Visuals and sound are meant to replicate the actual machine.

211588.overview: Slotter Up Mania 9 - Atsu Oki Daze! Mensore30 & Mensore 2-30 is a pachinko simulation game  developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2007. The game features a perfect simulation of 2 pachinko machines (Mensore30 & Mensore 2-30) with different levels of zoom, there also a sound, music and pictures galleries.

211589.overview: Slotter Up Mania 10: Pioneer Special III is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2008.

211599.overview:
In Tokyo Bus Annai, players drive on three real-world routes of the Toei Bus service. In addition to stopping at the right bus stops on time, triggering announcements, and ensuring passenger comfort by not accelerating or braking too harshly, drivers also have to follow the rules of traffic by stopping at traffic lights, obeying speed limits, and correctly indicating when turning or changing lanes. Part of a green "life bar" in the lower left corner of the screen turns red every time a rule is violated or a task not completed correctly. More serious violations, such as crashing into another vehicle, entail more serious consequences than minor mishaps, such as forgetting to announce the next stop. The life bar can be replenished by passing or stopping at stations on time. When the life bar turns entirely red, the player is forced to retire prematurely.

The three routes selectable in the game are the Niji 01 (across the Rainbow Bridge in Tokyo Bay area), Tian 70 (in the busy Shinjuku ward; this line was decommissioned in 2000), and Ume 76 (a more rural route in Western Tokyo). All the routes can be driven at noon, in the evening, or at night, with respectively different traffic density and amount of passengers. Some of the routes and schedules have to be unlocked by gaining experience in Story mode. Story mode also includes short cutscenes of interactions and monologues of some of the passengers, which play at certain bus stops. These cutscenes unlock brief files on the respective passenger's profiles in the main menu, along with occasional entries into an album. There is also a Free Run mode where no data is saved and no content can be unlocked.

A mini-game that can be downloaded to the Visual Memory unit is a quiz game on Japanese road signs.

213380.overview: Shinobido: Takumi (忍道　匠 lit. "Way of the Ninja: Artisan") is an expansion-pack disc of the original Shinobido: Way of the Ninja, released exclusively to the japanese market in 2006. It contains 130 new missions created by fans, members of the Spike developement staff and magazine editors, chosen to be the best amongst many other missions submitted in 2005. The creators of the submitted missions chosen by the development team received in-game credit, a copy of the game and an additional commemorative bonus item.

214062.overview:
School Rumble is a Japanese shonen manga series written and illustrated by Jin Kobayashi. First serialized in Weekly Shonen Magazine from October 22, 2002 to July 23, 2008, all 345 chapters were later collected in 22 tankobon volumes by Kodansha. Magazine Special published a parallel world story, School Rumble Z, monthly from August 20, 2008 to May 20, 2009. A romance comedy centering on relationships between Japanese high school students, School Rumble focuses on a love triangle involving the series' two protagonists, Kenji Harima and Tenma Tsukamoto, and one of their classmates, Oji Karasuma. The series often discards realism in favor of comedic effect.

School Rumble's popularity has resulted in its adaption into multiple forms of media. TV Tokyo broadcast a 26-episode anime program between October 2004 and April 2005. In December 2005, a two-part original video animation (OVA) entitled School Rumble: Extra Class was released. A second season, School Rumble: 2nd Semester, aired between April and September 2006. Finally, two more episodes, collectively entitled School Rumble: Third Semester, were bundled with the Japanese manga volumes 21 and 22. Three video games have been produced - two for the PlayStation 2 in July 2005 and July 2006, and one for the PlayStation Portable in 2005.

PLOT:
School Rumble is a romantic shonen comedy revolving around the daily lives of the students of Class 2-C at the fictional Yagami High School, as well as their friends and families. The main female protagonist is Tenma Tsukamoto, an unremarkable second-year high school student who secretly admires her eccentric, enigmatic, nice-guy classmate, Oji Karasuma. Tenma struggles to confess her feelings to Oji. He remains oblivious to her interest, instead seeking fulfillment by indulging in curry. The main male protagonist, delinquent Kenji Harima, similarly yearns for Tenma, attending school solely to be near her. Like Tenma, Harima has difficulty declaring his love, and whenever he summons the courage to do so, circumstances conspire against him.

PLAYSTATION 2 GAME:
School Rumble is inspired by the popular manga/animation but different from the recent PSP version of the game, Bandai presents a new story featuring the affable cast of School Rumble. The heroine of the series, Tenma Tsukamoto, is infatuated with the aloof Ouji Karasuma but he's transferring to another school next year. Strapped for time, Tenma has only until the end of the current school semester to convince Ouji that she's the girl for him. Tenma recruits her younger sister Yakumo and a few friends to help the cause. To complicate things, fellow student Kenji Harima has a crush on Tenma to complete the bizarre love triangle which leads to high jinks and hilarity.

The game is played in interactive sequences where Tenma speaks to school chums and obtains keywords during the course of a day. Based on the keywords that Tenma collects, events will change according to their context.

214064.overview:
School Rumble Ni-Gakki is just like the first game, a spin off of manga which also spanned a TV anime series. As the name implies, the game continues the second semester. This game is very similar to its prequel concerning overall gameplay and graphics style. Once again, the story revolves around a high-school girl, Tenma Tsukamoto, and her ventures regarding competitions, school and love in this romantic comedy adventure.

The story begins as Tenma and friends hear a rumor of a mansion within which sleeps a great treasure. You start off by selecting a character from whose perspective you'll follow the story. You also select a partner character, and based on your choice, the storyline changes.

216175.overview:
Psyvariar is a series of vertical scrolling shooters released in arcades in 2000 by Success, with several versions ported to the Sony PlayStation 2 in Japan and later Europe. Medium Unit was the first version to be made, followed by Psyvariar: Revision, and then a compilation titled Psyvariar: Complete Edition. The game contains a variety of stages. For the player to be able to choose harder stages he or she must have reached the required level or higher. 

Buzzing is the main gameplay mechanic of this game. The player has a small hitbox at the centre of the fighter ship, and this hitbox is much smaller when rolling. When the player gets hit in the hitbox with either a bullet or an enemy unit they lose a life, but if the player gets hit anywhere else on the ship, a 'buzz' occurs. When the player gets enough buzz points he or she will level up, gaining temporary invincibility. When a certain level is reached, the fighter will transform, and its bullet pattern will change.

216176.overview:
A danmaku-style shoot-'em-up from the studio behind the Cotton series, Psyvariar features a unique level-up system known as the "BUZZ System", in which players can level up their ships by both eliminating enemies and grazing past them (and their bullets) in order to receive temporary invincibility, gain new firing patterns, and access more difficult stages. It is also known for its rolling mechanic (used for dodging), "short bombs" (which gives temporary invincibility for use with the BUZZ System), and branching stage paths (based on the player's level).

The second version of the game was released as Psyvariar: Revision into arcades, then ported a year later for the Sony PlayStation 2. Along with updated graphics and rearranged stages, this version revamps the BUZZ System (now allowing players to buzz the same bullet multiple times), updates the rolling mechanic (allowing the Bomb button to be used to roll easily when the ship is out of bombs), and adds a new "replay mode" (where players can choose a stage and watch its high score replay before starting).

216215.overview:
Never 7: The End of Infinity is the first entry in the Infinity series of visual novels, and is followed by Ever 17, Remember 11, the spin-off 12Riven, and the reboot Code_18. 

You play as Makoto, a student who never attends the lectures at the school. As a punishment, you have to attend an extra seminar on an island with other classmates. However, when you arrive on the island, strange things start happening. A girl is found dead on April 6th, with a small bell in her hand. Immediately after that, you found yourself in the bed and see the date - April 1st! Was the vision of the girl just a dream, or do you possess a power to predict events? This is what you will have to find out, as a series of strange deaths make your seminar much more suspenseful than you have thought.

216615.overview: Love Smash 5.1: Tennis Robo no Gyakushuu is a Sports game, developed by HuneX and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2005.

216964.overview: An action simulation game in which cats in a fairy world unfold in order to solve the unreasonable task of the pug magistrate. The main character, the cat princess he served, has gone missing. In order to find Nekohime, she enlists the help of the Pug magistrate, but... Let's capture the gimmicks scattered in 5 areas such as Nodokanohara, Twilight Mountain, Ototo Castle, Ushi no Tokimura, and Tokezu no Sato. You can also synthesize items with the materials you bring back. You can bring up to 30 companions with you. Let's find the cat princess by making full use of 7 occupations + α such as swordsman, courier, acrobat, and firefighter.

217061.overview: You play as Momo Samejima, a special forces agent. Your mission is to assassinate the leader of an organization that's secretly selling a potent new drug, Perorin. You'll make use of guns and grenades as you sneak into a city and face off against enemies in 3D. The chief draw of the game, even though it promises action-packed excitement, is what the special forces agent is wearing -- a mini-skirt! She tackles thugs with swift kicks in her short, short skirt. She blasts away at goons in her stocking-accessorized, ultra-short China-look dress. She may even have to sashay down guarded hallways in nothing but a bikini, with no mini-skirt on at all!

217622.overview: Shadow Hearts II: Director's Cut (PlayStation 2 the Best) (シャドウハーツII ディレクターズカット [ベスト版]) is a RPG video game published by Aruze Corp released on March 10th, 2005 for the PlayStation 2.

217690.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 28: The Bushidou - Tsujigiri Ichidai (ＳＩＭＰＬＥ２０００シリーズ　Ｖｏｌ．２８　ＴＨＥ　武士道　～辻斬り一代～) is a Action/Hack and Slash video game published by D3Publisher and released for the PlayStation 2.

218254.overview:
Sometime in the year 20XX, a super computer goes awry and ordinary citizens are recruited into a virtual world where everyone hefts massive bombs. Once hefted, bombs may be hurled at opponents in a frenetic blast 'em up. Run around the digital landscape, gather a bomb and then time your attacks against roving combatants while being pursued by other bomb toting miscreants.

Chain reactions may be linked together to force multiple bomb blasts against foes and seal their doom. Six characters are available at the outset of the game: a schoolgirl, a nurse, a drunken salaryman, a security guard and a couple of others culled from the populace. Four additional characters may be unlocked as players progress through the bombing action.

Welcome to the PoiPoi bomb throwing festival, set in the year 20XX. This high-action puzzle game has you run around fields gathering bombs, Bomberman-style. Pick-up, set, roll, and throw bombs, with the ultimate goal of blowing opponents sky-high. The key to victory is stringing bomb explosions together to create the ultimate blast.

The developers included a two-player cooperative mode that lets you bring a friend and blow up stuff together. A range of different characters is available for selection, including a female student, a robot, and German bomb disposal expert Max Ernst.

Play action game of brains hit the right brain left brain also may use both! Rolled to run most comprehensive field, without regret picking up the bomb! Defeat the enemy in the chain of blasting using or action "put" and "roll" and "throw", a blast! I record the mission of more than 60 match play, in co-op! Exhilaration defeat the enemy at a time of mass is unbearable.

218500.overview:
Enter the world of illegal mortorcycle racing.

Drive your custom bike as dangerously as you can to gain points and try to pull off spectacular stunts such as wheelies, stoppies and slides.

In the meantime you are going to have to stay ahead of all the other racers.

And could be there anything more satisfying than watching your mates eat dust in the two player split screen mode?

- Race against 12 competitors in the story mode.
- Split screen vs mode
- Large variety of special moves
- 11 bikes to choose from

219090.overview:
Silent Line: Armored Core, known in Japan as Armored Core 3: Silent Line[a], is a 2003 third-person shooter mecha video game developed by FromSoftware for the PlayStation 2. It is the seventh entry in the Armored Core series and a direct sequel to 2002's Armored Core 3. In 2009, Silent Line: Armored Core was ported to the PlayStation Portable.

Some time after the liberation of the underground city Layered in Armored Core 3, mankind has begun reclaiming the surface. The corporations explore the world and expand their reach, constructing factories and fortresses on the new lands. While exploring the planet, several teams vanish behind the border of a mysterious region known as the Silent Line. The player takes the role of a newly-registered Raven who must unravel the secrets of the region.

Gameplay in Silent Line offers incremental feature updates to the franchise, namely the addition of player-trained computer-controlled versions of the player's Armored Core and a first-person view. Otherwise, the game retains its core structure of customizing mechs, taking on missions or fighting in the Arena, and multiplayer versus modes.

219304.overview:
Strawberry Panic! is an adventure visual novel, detailing the day-to-day relationships between the students of three girls' high schools. You can choose "Boy Mode" or "Girl Mode". If you choose "Boy Mode", you will be a brother of a heroine. If you choose "Girl Mode", you will play as a girl who has transferred to one of the Astraea Hill schools and meets other students there. The game features unique systems that recreate a girl's feeling of falling in love.

This 'Limited Edition' version (SLPS-25611) differs from the standard version (SLPS-25612). It comes with alternate cover art featuring Nagisa & Tamao, slipcase, drama CD, and customizable student ID cards for each of the Astraea Hill schools.

219306.overview:
Strawberry Panic! is an adventure visual novel, detailing the day-to-day relationships between the students of three girls' high schools. You can choose "Boy Mode" or "Girl Mode". If you choose "Boy Mode", you will be a brother of a heroine. If you choose "Girl Mode", you will play as a girl who has transferred to one of the Astraea Hill schools and meets other students there. The game features unique systems that recreate a girl's feeling of falling in love.

This is the standard version of the game (SLPS-25612).

219585.overview:
Samurai 7 is a visual novel based on the anime of the same name (which itself is based on the 1954 Akira Kurosawa film Seven Samurai).

The story is about Ibuki, a boy from Kanna village, who aspires to become a samurai and wants to save Kanna village from the Nobuseri bandits. Gameplay involves making choices during dialogue with characters.

219586.overview: Sentou Kokka Kai: New Operations is a Japanese military turn-based strategy game released for the Sony PlayStation 2 on March 31, 2005, by publisher Kadokawa Shoten.

417700.overview: Spectral Force Chronicle is a tactical/simulation tactical role-playing game developed by Xpec Entertainment and Idea Factory, released exclusively in Japan on April 28, 2005, for the Sony PlayStation 2.

417706.overview: Sentimental Prelude is a Japanese romance simulation visual novel developed and published by NEC Interchannel. It was released exclusively for the PlayStation 2 on October 28, 2004. Serving as a prequel to the popular Sentimental Graffiti franchise, the game features character designs by artist Tomohisa Kai and a scenario written by Raita Okura.

417708.overview:
Space Venus starring Morning Musume (スペースヴィーナス starring モーニング娘。) is music visual software, published by Sony Music Entertainment (Japan), released January 11, 2001. Space Venus bills itself not as a game, but as "Music Visual Software". It takes the Japanese pop group Morning Musume and puts them in the role of the crew of a space station, charged with generating Life Oriented Virtual Energy (LOVE). The player chooses an area of the space station, where they'll find different kinds of video experiences.

Some areas simply play standard video clips, either taking place in the fictional space setting or showing behind-the-scenes footage from the making of this game. Some are special 360° panoramic videos where panning and zooming can be controlled with the gamepad.

Some sections are more heavily interactive. One section, called simply "Mini-game", allows you to shoot at spaceships flying around the space station. Another section, "Morning Musume TVDJ", reuses the system from Sony's earlier PS2 game TVDJ and allows the player to reedit and add effects to several of the group's music videos in real-time. Failure to time placement of song sections appropriately results in repeating that part of the song before one progresses.

419163.overview: Shinki Gensou: Spectral Souls II is a Role-Playing game, developed and published by Idea Factory, which was released in Japan in 2005.

419168.overview: Standard Daisenryaku: Dengekisen (スタンダード大戦略 電撃戦) is an entry in SystemSoft Alpha's Daisenryaku series. At first, it was released by Sammy, and re-released by Sega as the Sega the Best.

419301.overview:
When Suzu's big sister figure, Mao, disappeared, she was summoned back to her rural home town to succeed her role as Tamayori-hime, the miko who'd sacrifice herself to keep the land safe from the wrath of the sea lord. Suzu just knew that being Tamayori-hime has a small group of retainers, but no real idea of what she has to do to fulfill her role. She's just determined to find out why Mao disappeared, or who took her. Before Suzu could get used to her new life, however, the sea lord strikes, sending his demons to destroy the village. And the head of the demon troops, Toyotama-hime is none other than Mao.
The remake of the Hisui no Shizuku: Hiiro no Kakera 2.

419305.overview: Spectral Force: Radical Elements is the latest installment of the popular simulation RPG series. This time the story takes place in a small kingdom called Orutaded, 400 years before the first Neverland great wars. You play the role of the king of Orutaded named Tonaty, who is on a journey to seek helps from the allied kingdom Milria, to battle against the invading kingdom Rafarm.During battles, you can experience a large-scale combat of 1000 vs 1000 soldiers in the battle field. After completing a battle, you can collect elements, which can be used to create new troops, buildings and new technologies.

421033.overview: Stepping Selection is a rhythm game for the PlayStation 2. It was released exclusively for Japanese markets on March 4, 2000. The game is based on Jaleco's Stepping Stage series of arcade games, featuring shortened versions of popular songs accompanied by videos loosely related to them.

421220.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 114: The Onna Okappichi Torimonochou - Oharu-chan GoGoGo! (ＳＩＭＰＬＥ２０００シリーズ　Ｖｏｌ．１１４　ＴＨＥ　女岡っピチ捕物帳 ～お春ちゃんＧＯＧＯＧＯ！～) is a Beat 'em up video game published by D3Publisher released on February 22nd, 2007 for the PlayStation 2.

422312.overview:
Simoun: Ibara Sensou - Fuuin no Remersion is an Adventure game, developed by Pinegrow and published by Marvelous Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 2007. It follows the story of a group of priestesses who pilot 'Simoun'; mysterious, ancient flying vessels, in the defence of their homeland, Simulacrum.

This 'Limited Edition' version (SLPS-25688) differs from the standard version (SLPS-25689). It comes with an alternate cover art slipcase and bonus disc.

422723.overview:
Based on the anime adaption of the manga by Moyoco Anno.

Aim to become a popular witch! Raise your charm and 'pick up' the boys' hearts! Make-up, exercise, making sweets and studying at the Dollhouse will all raise your charm. Use the hearts you capture to purchase clothes from the "Makai Mail Order Book", including outfits from the anime. Includes new original illustrations and full voice over by the anime cast.

424474.overview: Players take part in a fictional tandem ski jumping competition. Choose from a number of nations - each with their own unique way of jumping!

425193.overview:
In S.D. 772 (A.D. 2858), the game starts on the resort planet of Hyda IV. Fayt Leingod is on a family vacation with his parents Robert and Ryoko Leingod, and his childhood friend Sophia Esteed. Fayt is enjoying his holidays and ignores his college work—related to the field of Symbological Genetics—by playing games, specifically combat simulation holographic games, which earns him his father's reproach. Everything seems fairly normal... until the galactic faction known as the Vendeeni invades the planet, their intentions unknown.

Fayt and his family are forced to flee on the Helre, but he is separated from them and his escape pod ends up crash-landing on the planet Vanguard III. His meeting with Cliff Fittir only proves enigmatic, as he has a special interest in Fayt as does the leader of the anti-Federation group Quark. His journey thereafter will not only reveal a few truths about himself, but about the origin of their very universe.

425625.overview: The Saiyuki Saruden: Based on the legendary Monkey series, this game requires you to protect the priestess Tripitaka from maurading demons with help of course from Pigsy, Sandy and Dragon. Genki awaits the appearance of the fractions demons from the seminal series with bated breath.

425983.overview:
Hakoniwa Tetsudou Bluetrain Tokkyuuhen is a 3d model train simulation that lets players live the life of a train driver on several licensed JR (Japan Railway) train lines, including the northern Hokkaidou, East JR, West JR, and more.

Create a mini-town "diorama" of sorts where the famous Blue Train line from JR Hokkaido factors as a convenient form of transportation along with other famous train lines from Japan. Players may position buildings, attractions and other venues to draw foot traffic and visitors to towns which lie adjacent to the railroad. The Blue Train arcs across east and west Japan with stops between Shikoku and Kyushu. Over 160 types of trains may be used in your miniature railroad operation to add big variety.

425986.overview: Hanafuda are playing cards of Japanese origin (karuta cards), used to play a number of games. The name literally translates as "flower cards".

426000.overview:
Magnificent view of the world of Kung Fu with a spectacular storyline!

From your mysterious old master, learn the ways of Kung Fu and fight enemies of Kenpo, pigtailed twins and weaponed soldiers!

You master the way of each of the four fist!

435586.overview:
Choose a hero, male or female and battle against an evil organization, your enemies are some sort of ugly aliens!

Lobster-man, yellow monster-man, a strange egyptian woman and a poweful ancient samurai are only a few of the strange foes you have to overcome. More you fight, more you became powerful: between each stage the Professor gives you the possibility to improve your fighting tecniques, choose what suits you best!

438168.overview: Igo is a Miscellaneous game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

438359.overview: Shoukan Shoujo: Elemental Girl Calling is a Japanese tactical adventure game developed by Bridge NetShop and published by Kadokawa Shoten for the PlayStation 2 on December 6, 2007. The game was exclusive to Japan.

438998.overview:
A nameless young salaryman, bored with his ho-hum life, has started having strange dreams and visions. He hears calls for help from a distant voice, and catches glimpses of a fantastic kingdom not of this world. One night, he comes home from work and finds a curious program on his laptop, which seems to be a simple picture-book creator. Intrigued, he starts it up, when suddenly a bright light envelopes him. When he awakens, he is in the strange land he saw in his dreams, surrounded by five beautiful young girls. They believe he is the savior that they have been waiting for, and without any way to return to his home, the man has no choice but to join them on their adventure.

Kanojo no Densetsu, Boku no Sekiban (Her Legend, My Picture) is a traditional Japanese-style visual novel. The player reads along as the story proceeds, occasionally making decisions which will lead to one of over 20 different endings. Somewhat anachronistically, the protagonist has access to his laptop, which he can use to review previous events, check his email, or fiddle with a variety of settings and other features.

439111.overview: The Kanshikikan is an adventure title where players take on the role of a forensic investigator. The first installment of what would later become a sub-series of its own.

439124.overview: Baskelian is an anime based street basketball game, featuring a total of 80 playable characters from the manga series. Various play modes are available, include 1 on 1, League Game, Championship, Battle, and Trading. There is a card collection feature in the game, over 100 kinds of card can be obtained from the game.

439842.overview: The unlikely partnership and adventures of Meguru Momoi, Miako Tachibana and their newspaper club continue with the fourth installement of the series (the lastest one in Playstation 2). Konohana 4: Yami wo Harau Inori is the fourth installment in the story-driven mystery adventure game series, featuring anime-style character art and a text-based adventure/conversation system. The game now features the all-new history mode that allows players to go back and read through past conversations and events, as well as new help and skip functions. In addition to the new "Watson" character research tool, Konohana 4 also features a number of other upgrades, not the least of which is the possibility of playing through multiple ending scenarios.

440316.overview:
Simple 2000 Ultimate Series vol.10 - Love Songs: A dating simulation anime adventure game from HuneX, Love * Songs incorporates an "Emotional Talk System" that allows the player to interact with characters via combinations on the controller via corresponding phrases. Is the first game in which the character Riho Futaba appears.

In the game you're a new student at the famous Akimitsu School whose claim to fame are the Japanese idols among it's student body. Naturally, your goal in the game is to date up to eight of the idols and work your way into their lives by interaction and proper formality. In addition to just talking, other activities which help your love ambition include working a part time job to show her you're industrious, buying little gifts that suit her tastes and making sure you're always in her line of sight. Familiarity breeds intimacy...

There were three sets of the limited editions: Limited Box A features idols Auno and Yuka on the cover. Limited Box B sets us up with Minako, Riho, and Arisu. Finally, Box C features Ryouko, Kana, and Miyu on the box cover. All three editions include a radio broadcast CD and a desktop clock shaped in a half-circle. The right side of each clock matches the color of the box, i.e Limited Edition A's clock is pink. Only 3,400 units of each limited edition were produced and shipped to market.

440323.overview: Mahjong is a Miscellaneous game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

440377.overview:
Shuumatsu Shoujo Gensou Alicematic Apocalypse: In 2022, the world is afflicted with a mysterious phenomenon. Adjoining multi-dimension world assimilates and becomes another space, dimension assimilation phenomenon called "Petulation". Humans can't approach these areas and their number keeps increasing...

One day, Kuroudo receives summons from the government to help the related scientific investigation at Shin Shinonome Academy located on the newly reclaimed land in Tokyo bay.

He has no idea what is going on. But the world gets closer to the destruction little by little. All he has is his skill of swordplay and one sword.

There he meets others, whom just like him are destined to fight for the future of mankind...

440383.overview: Makai Tensho is an dungeon-crawler RPG based on the 1967 novel of the same title by Futaro Yamada. Similar to Chunsoft's Mysterious Dungeon series, the player controls the hero Yagyu Jubei through randomly-generated floors, which are filled with enemies, items, and traps, searching for the exit and attempting to survive. Movement and actions are turn-based, with all enemies taking a turn at the same time as the player. Weapons will degrade with use, though new ones of varying types can be found within the dungeons. After clearing a certain number of floors, the player reaches a village, where they may rest and save.

441263.overview: Mesaze! Super Hustler!! is a Miscellaneous game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2005.

441264.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.122 - The Ningyo Hime Monogatari - Mermaid Prism is a japanese dating sim, this female-targeted love simulation puts players in the role of a high school student that one day gets warped to a separate world, becoming a mermaid along the way! Good thing she was a member of her school's swimming club! The game allows players to move around on a map, viewing events and gaining experience.

The Limited Edition features a Drama CD, 28 pages book and some illustrations.

441265.overview: Mesaze! Super Bowler is a Sports game, developed and published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2005.

441273.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.098 - The Roman Sabou: In the game the player takes the role of the only daughter of a family that will have to run a sweet shop during a year of time. The game features over 884 different sweets to make. During the game the player will go with one of the 6 different boys to different places around the town to look for new ingredients for the different sweets, and also check often the balance of the money's shop since if there are loses at the end of any of the months is game over.

If the player got enough money he can improve the sweet shop buying a new one, go to the town's shop to buy new ingredients and also make new recipes combining three different ingredients.

441324.overview: Mezase! Chess Champion is a Miscellaneous game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2004.

441341.overview: It is the early Showa era, during the early stages of World War II. In Japan many prestigious boys' boarding schools exist, where students study mathematics, science, philosophy, and German language, hoping to make a future for themselves, while indulging in women and alcohol in their free time.

442305.overview:
A compilation of various SNK NEO-GEO games.
Credits: UsagiRu

Includes the following games:

-SNK ARCADE CLASSICS Vol.1-
Art of Fighting
Baseball Stars
Burning Fight
Fatal Fury
King of the Monsters
Last Resort
Magician Lord

Sengoku
Shock Troopers

The King of Fighters '94
Top Hunter
World Heroes

Aggressors of Dark Kombat
Ninja Masters - Haou Ninpou Chou
Ninja Combat
Ninja Commando
Twinkle Star Sprites
