Metal Slug
Metal Slug 2
Metal Slug X
Metal Slug 3
Metal Slug 4
Metal Slug 5
Metal Slug 6

-SENGOKU ANTHOLOGY-
Sengoku
Sengoku 2
Sengoku 3

-FUUUN SUPER COMBO*-
Savage Reign
Kizuna Encounter: Super Tag Battle

442318.overview: The training simulation "Seaman" is back in a complete version. Beginner-friendly functions have been added, such as a "guide function" that helps you when you are worried about training, and a "training diary" that can record the owner's training status. The variety of words that Seaman can understand has increased, and the range of conversations has expanded. The time to growth has also been shortened.

443124.overview: An alien investigation communication game in which you take on the role of the director of a certain research institute to investigate captured "aliens" who do not understand the language and elucidate their purpose! By investigating captured aliens for 10 minutes a day, you can gradually understand the language and various events occur. There are 729 types of aliens.

443174.overview: An updated version of "way of the samurai" ("samurai" in japan) released in Japan in 2003. It is based on the Western versions of the game, and as such, it includes the non-sword weapons, bugfixes, the exit for ending the game early, hard mode, and horizontal text of those versions. The game is also playable in English.

443178.overview:
Cromartie High School by Eiji Nonaka, is a Japanese comedy manga, which was subsequently adapted into an anime and a 2005 live-action movie titled Cromartie High - The Movie directed by Yudai Yamaguchi.

Sakigake!! Cromatier High School (Sakigake!! Kuromati Koukou) is a party game featuring a variety of mini-game competitions for up to four players. At the heart of the title lies a simple board game, set in Cromartic High School. Depending on the fields you land on, different (often jumorous) events and mini-games get triggered. Only released in Japan.

443188.overview: Sakura Yuki Gekka takes place during a holiday stretch but instead of enjoying the vacation away from school, the player is stuck on barren school grounds with a few classmates. Converse with schoolmates, seek romance and perhaps make a positive out of a negative experience. The stranded students are soon joined by a mysterious transfer student who adds a new wrinkle to the interaction.

443204.overview: Sakigake!! Cromatier High School - Kore wa Hyottoshite Game Nanoka! Hen (Sakigake!! Kuromati Koukou - Kore wa Hyottoshite Game Nanoka! Hen): Similar to the manga and animated series, everyday situations with an outlandish bent pop up in PS2 Sakigaki!! Kuromati Koukou and players contribute to the conversations and situations to move the story along. Along with the interaction sequences where the Kuromati crew make their way through each day, there's a group of mini games to play including slots and a primitive fighting challenge where players attempt to defeat a larger than life Freddy Mercury with a stick.

443817.overview: One day, Genjou makes up her mind to visit Tenjiku to get a scripture, which is believed to save the world. She meets Goku, Hakkai, Gojou and Gyokuryu along the way, but it is really hard to take care of them because they have totally different personalities. She somehow continues her trip with them solving various troubles. As they get closer to Tenjiku, the secret purpose of their trip gradually comes out....

444293.overview: Released on March 18, 2004, this is a visual novel game developed and released by Bandai.

444294.overview: Scared Rider Xechs - Stardust Lovers is a Fandisc of Scared Rider Xechs, and takes place during the main storyline and basically delves into wot our IS kids get up to during their non-ganking free time.

444295.overview: "Saka Tsuku 2002: J.League Pro Soccer Club o Tsukurou!" is a soccer club management simulation game published by Sega.

444297.overview: Four Saint Beast descended to Earth to investigate the cause of the mysterious disappearance of Guardian Angels. At the behest of the Goddess of Heaven, the hero (the character you are playing) is the liaison between the Heaven and the four Saint Beast stationed in Earth. You have Guardian Angels also searching for clues and help the Saint Beast figure out the mystery...

444298.overview: The game is based on a manga and animé series of the same name. It is set in future, during the time of World War III. The two heroes Shuuji and Chise are a boy and a girl who live on Hokkaido, the northern island of Japan. Gradually, they fall in love with each other, but during an assault on Hokkaido Shuuji discovers the terrible truth: Chise is not an ordinary girl, but the ultimate weapon Japan relies on in order to win the war. The struggle for Chise's humanity and their love begins...

444300.overview: When an alien invasion gets into gear, six boys are recruited to combat the nefarious threat from outer space. Troops of otherworldly aliens are invading earth. To protect the planet and humanity, six chosen youths are recruited into the Scared Rider team under you, their commander. In any other genre of game, there'd be a cast of trigger-happy grunts who blast away in blazing action sequences. However, Scared Rider Xechsisn't a shooter nor is it a tactical simulation. SRX is an otome game or a boy's love adventure where the protagonist is girl named Akira Asagi and she's surrounded by six hunky guys whom she directs against the aliens.

444303.overview: Hana Yamada is just an average student studying about the Sangoku era. In the library, she found an odd book (the Romance of Three Kingdoms), and the moment she moved one of the chess pieces inside, she loses her consciousness, suddenly surrounded by a flash of light and is transported to another world. Here is her chance to gain some first hand knowledge of the Sangoku era.

444304.overview: Riku is a stage actor, traveling around frequently. One day, he comes to a small town and gets involved in a mysterious world as if led by fate. Strange and sad past memories. This town was the strange world where the whale floats in the sky. He has to take the "final test" to solve the world's mysteries.

445045.overview: Play the role of Sanzo and lead a band of handsome, but troublesome men on your quest for the holy sutras. Travel through the land torn by poverty and corruption. Rescue the people from the demons and villains and keep your team in line.

445046.overview:
Saikyou no Igo 2 (最強の囲碁2) is a Japanese board game video game based on the traditional game of Go, published by Unbalance for the Sony PlayStation 2.

The game features an AI engine tailored for players to practice and play Go. Because it was exclusively released in Japan, the menus, tutorials, and settings are fully in Japanese.

445048.overview: Saikyou Ginsei Shogi 4 (also known as Sekai Saikyou Ginsei Shogi 4) is a traditional Japanese board game simulation developed by Silver Star Japan and published by Magnolia. Released on May 27, 2004, it holds the distinction of being the sole entry in the Ginsei Shogi franchise developed for the PlayStation 2 console.

446294.overview: Saikyou Toudai Shogi 2003 is a shogi game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2003.

446297.overview: Saikyou Toudai Shogi 4 is a shogi game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2002.

446299.overview: Formation Final is a Sports game, published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2003.

446300.overview: Sekai no Subete - Two of Us: Hiroshi returned to his hometown after 8 years in Tokyo trying to attain his childhood dream and failing to do so. Feeling powerless and lacking support from his family, he could only think about giving up. He felt that a poor student like him was unneeded and there was no longer any place for him. That was before he met Tomoko at the light music club and realized that he was not the only one in the same situation.

446302.overview: Thirteen average citizens have been kidnapped and holed up in a room within a building. No one remembers how they got there but everyone has been given a compact personal digital assistant. On that PDA is an assignment and a single card (2-10, Jack, Queen, King, or Ace). For example, the person who holds the Queen PDA has to survive for 2 days and 23 hours while the holder of the King PDA must obtain 5 other PDAs.

446307.overview: Saikyo Shogi Gekisashi Special is a shogi game, developed and published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2006.

446308.overview: Saikyou Toudai Shogi 3 is a shogi game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2001.

446309.overview: Sinbad Adventure wa Enomoto Kanako de Dou Desu ka is a pachinko game, published by Nippon Amuse, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446419.overview:
This Unofficial Update Mod adds a recreation of the content from the Xbox DLC along with CW Hoth, CW Endor, and GCW Geonosis. It also adds a few additional hunt modes, and Hero Assault (Heroes vs Villains) on every map, along with a slightly expanded Galactic Conquest. Also patched for SWBFSpy multiplayer. These files overwrite some base game files to add the Alt-Addon system, from which the mod runs. The user can then install future Alt-Addon packages using this system.

Features:
* Rhen Var Harbor, Rhen Var Citadel, Bespin Cloud City, and Yavin Arena BF1 maps based on their Xbox DLC renditions, complete with their original gamemodes and Xbox textures
* Kit Fisto and Asajj Ventress join the fray as new heroes, available simultaneously thanks to Ryan Hank's animation fixes
* Hero Assault (Heroes vs Villains) on every map
* Clone Wars Hoth
* Clone Wars Endor
* Galactic Civil War Geonosis
* AI Hero Support on all new maps listed above (singleplayer only)
* Some restored or added Hunt Modes
* Updated Galactic Conquest layout, now including Bespin and Rhen Var
* Galactic Conquest now allows gamemode selection on some planets (e.g. CTF or Conquest)
* Patched to support SWBFSpy Multiplayer; download, install, and join any online PS2 players! (thanks, SG-17)
* A couple secret cheats in singleplayer/splitscreen
* Fixed splitscreen Galactic Conquest extra planets appearing without valid mission scripts

446502.overview: The player takes the role of Rion, a young boy (son of a famous master painter) that attempt to both discover his life goal and get some Love with one of the girls that goes to the same high school he now attends. Rion have travelled around the world, and now he has return to his hometown, as soon as Rion arrives town he starts meeting the classmates, teachers at his first day at the school, then he goes to Shizuru's house, the mother of Suzuha (she is one year younger than Rion), where he is going to live during the game.

446508.overview: Ohno Akito is a military otaku. Akito dropped out of school a year ago and is now camping on a small island off Okinawa, where he went in the forlorn hope that the American military presence would give him a chance to play with real guns. He's unexpectedly approached by a foreigner girl, Shizuka, who tells him he's in a restricted area. That night, Akito sees a B-2 stealth bomber flying overhead, and realizes something is happening that shouldn't be. The next day, as he's trying to break into Kadena Air Base to get a closer look at the B-2, he runs into Shizuka again...

446540.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Ultimate Vol. 1: Love*Smash! Super Tennis Players is a basic tennis game for one to four players. A secret underground society has assembled eight of the greatest players in the world to compete for fame and fortune. The game features both Tournament (story) and Exhibition modes and offers both Singles and Doubles play.

There are eight characters to choose from, plus two hidden unlockable characters, each with their own abilities and signature special move, as well as a variety of costumes to unlock. A total of eight different courts are available, ranging from traditional stadiums to outlandish locales such as an army base, construction site, and mountain top.

446558.overview:
This racing game has enjoyed a good reputation, in particular for its "CD Edit" mode where courses are created using tracks from the user's own CD or DVD. The game features 40 convertibles in all, and eight color choices available for each vehicle. Grab prizes during race, which can be used to improve the performance of your engine, suspension, or purchase new cars with additional power.

Feel the atmosphere of dynamic driving, as emergency events and catastrophes affect the course during a race!
But races aren't all this game has! There's a combat mode as well, which can be enjoyed in either single player or against a friend in split screen mode. In the Survival Mode for sabotage during a run. In the Survival Mode, you will be given a bazooka to counter attack against your enemies.

446573.overview: Simple 2000 Honkaku Shikou vol.004 - The Mahjong is a mahjong game featuring different difficulty levels (From beginner to advanced), 30 different kind of professional opponents (men & women) and 2 different game modes, Annual Waging War (sort of a story mode) and free Waging War (Sort of a free mode in which the player can play against the professional players that he defeats in the story mode), featuring real tournament names. The player can choose at the beginning of the game between a male or a female character.

446587.overview: Simple 2000 Honkaku Shikou vol.001 - The Shogi is a shogi game featuring different difficulty levels (From beginner to advanced), 8 different kind of opponents and different game modes, 2D & 3D boards, and 3 different locations. There are also a quiz mode with over 100 different shogi questions.

446598.overview: Pachinko Paradise 7 is one of the many titles in Irem's long-running pachinko simulation series. It features faithful 3D recreations of two pachinko machines made by Sanyo Bussan: CR Edokko Gen-san L7, CR Edokko Gen-san M6. There are two modes available: Tsūjō (Normal) mode allows the player to modify a wide range of settings for each machine, while Jissen (Battle) mode challenges the player to win as many balls as possible on the default settings with a limited starting pool and time limit. There is also a View mode where the various animations that play on the in-game display can be freely viewed. There is no story mode.

446637.overview:
Pachinko Paradise 8 is one of the many titles in Irem's long-running pachinko simulation series. It features a faithful 3D recreation of the CR Shin Umi Monogatari M27 pachinko machine made by Sanyo Bussan. There are two modes available: Tsūjō (Normal) mode allows the player to modify a wide range of settings for each machine, while Jissen (Battle) mode challenges the player to win as many balls as possible on the default settings with a limited starting pool and time limit. There is also a View mode where the various animations that play on the in-game display can be freely viewed.

New in this installment is the first episode of the Pachi-Pro Fūunroku story mode. The player takes control of a young man who has just arrived in PachiPara Town looking to solve the mysteries surrounding his father's death. The player can move between three different pachinko parlors, as well as return home to the protagonist's apartment, which can be customized with items won from playing pachinko. The game proceeds much like a basic adventure game, speaking to other characters to gain information or challenge them to a pachinko duel. There are three different female characters with whom relationships can be pursued, and the ending will change depending on which character the player becomes closest to.

446661.overview: Takumi Kaizu is a normal high school student enjoying his final year in school with the rest of his friends. Over the years, he has made good memories with these friends of his, most of whom are girls, though apparently still have no overt feelings of attraction towards any of them. When asked by his best male friend Osamu Funada if he likes anyone, Takumi starts to think about it though is still confused on what to do next. With his last summer in high school quickly approaching, Takumi decides to find someone to like by the end of summer vacation.

446664.overview: Sanyo Pachinko Paradise 6 - Ginpani Daisuizokukan is the first PS2 release in Irem's long-running pachinko simulation series. It features faithful 3D recreations of three pachinko machines made by Sanyo Bussan: CR Gingira Panic L5, CR Gingira Panic L6, and CR Gingira Panic M7. There are two modes available: Tsujo (Normal) mode allows the player to modify a wide range of settings for each machine, while Jissen (Battle) mode challenges the player to win as many balls as possible on the default settings with a limited starting pool and time limit. There is also a View mode where the various animations that play on the in-game display can be freely viewed. There is no story mode.

446666.overview: Sanyo Pachinko Paradise 10 is a pachinko simulation game, published by Irem, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446673.overview:
Pachinko Paradise 11 is one of the many titles in Irem's long-running pachinko simulation series. It features faithful 3D recreations of two pachinko machines made by Sanyo Bussan: CR Shin Umi Monogatari M8Z and CR Shin Umi Monogatari M6Z. There are two modes available: Tsūjō (Normal) mode allows the player to modify a wide range of settings for each machine, while Jissen (Battle) mode challenges the player to win as many balls as possible on the default settings with a limited starting pool and time limit. There is also a View mode where the various animations that play on the in-game display can be freely viewed.

Pachi-Pro Fūunroku returns again with Pachi-Pro Fūunroku 3: Saraba Gindama no Ōkami, concluding the storyline introduced in the first title. The game returns to the adventure style of the first two titles, but adds a much greater degree of freedom to affect the outcome of the story. There are a large number of locations to visit apart from the pachinko parlors, and there are several very different endings that can be reached depending on the player's choice. The relationship system has also returned with several new girls to pursue, for a total of eleven.

446703.overview: Slotter Up Core 6: Bakuenda! Kyojin no Hoshi II is a gambling game, developed and published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2005.

446711.overview: You play as Makoto, a transfer student attending a school in modern day Harajuku (a trendy area of Tokyo near Shibuya and Shinjuku). You're not sure of what you want to do with your life and are given many choices, from entering the performing arts club, to going hardcore with your studies. Your choice will determine the path the game's story follows. Steady X Study makes use of the "ASV" (Around Search View) system that allows you to look around your environment. While sitting at your desk in class, you can press a button on the D-pad to look at one of the girls sitting next to you. While waiting to meet someone at the train station, you can look around and will likely find new things, including secret movies and events.

446715.overview: Slotter UP Core 4: Don-chan Gekiuchi! Jissen Pachi-Slot Ore Izuma is a gambling game, published by Dorart, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446725.overview:
Pachinko Paradise 9 is one of the many titles in Irem's long-running pachinko simulation series. It features faithful 3D recreations of two pachinko machines made by Sanyo Bussan: CR Shin Umi Monogatari M56 and CR Shin Umi Monogatari L52. There are two modes available: Tsūjō (Normal) mode allows the player to modify a wide range of settings for each machine, while Jissen (Battle) mode challenges the player to win as many balls as possible on the default settings with a limited starting pool and time limit. There is also a View mode where the various animations that play on the in-game display can be freely viewed.

The popular Pachi-Pro Fūunroku story mode returns with Pachi-Pro Fūunroku 2: Senjukannon no Nazo, a direct sequel to the first installment which picks up the story right where it left off before. The protagonist has just arrived at Shinkai Town, following a lead to find his father's killer. The game proceeds much the same as before, with the player moving between different locations speaking to other characters and playing pachinko. In addition to the three pachinko halls and the player's apartment, there are also now a restaurant and a shrine, where different story events may occur. It is also now possible to learn and use special moves for use in the pachinko battles. As before, it is possible to pursue a relationship with one of five different girls, with the game's ending changing accordingly.

446739.overview:
Our protagonist Takashi Akito is the young heir to a large conglomerate.

He just came back to Japan after graduating from an English university so he can take the ropes but... his father's will is hiding several secrets! What will be of Akito and the men he becomes entangled with...?

446750.overview: Saikyou Toudai Shogi Special is a shogi game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2002.

446765.overview: Saikyou Toudai Shogi 2004 is a shogi game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2004.

446767.overview: Low-priced version of way of the samurai 2 released in Japan in 2004, with several bug fixes, a new sword, new fighting modes and dialogue additions, and additional elements.

446774.overview: Simple 2000 Honkaku Shikou vol.002 - The Igo is a igo game featuring different difficulty levels (From beginner to advanced), 8 different kind of opponents and different game modes, 2D & 3D boards, 3 boards, and 3 different locations. The game also features a complete igo tutorial in japanese.

446863.overview: A game where you can act out a play yourself and experience the roles and situations of your dreams.

446885.overview: Shin Best Play Pro Yakyuu is a baseball game, published by Enterbrain, which was released in Japan in 2003.

446997.overview: Saikyou Toudai Shogi Special II is a shogi game, developed and published by Mainichi Communications, which was released in Japan in 2005.

447037.overview:
Shikaku Tantei - Sora no Sekai - Thousand Dreams is an adventure game in which the player takes the role of a detective that have to investigate in a mansion the assassination (or accident or suicide) that 3 sisters that lives there hire him to solve.

The gameplay is examinate each room and each character that are there to gather clues that allows him to advance through the story of the game and in his investigation. In some times during the examination of items or talking to the characters a points bar appear and the player can use the Triangle Button to use the point and advance in that part.

447051.overview: Mamoru, the game's main character, wants to enter a pastry school in order to become a pastry cook. Trouble is that the school is girls-only and hence he has no other choice but to disguise himself as a girl. Obviously this will lead to a lot of confusing events. Depending on your actions, the game's scenarios and events will change. While Mamoru also tries to win over his female fellow student of choice, he also has to show his skills in a school-intern pastry competition. Provided he wins this one, he will be able to compete in a country-wide competiton.

447054.overview: Koichiro Ogata, a male first-year high school student who does not have any interest in matters such as love or romance. The high school he is admitted to, named Aikyo Academy, used to be an all-girl school formally named Aikyo Girl's Academy, and still carries a high population of female students. He starts school with his childhood friend Asahi Kamijo, his younger stepsister Mio Ogata, and best male friend Masanori Shinozaki. Koichiro eventually meets two more female upperclassmen from the same school named Clarissa Satsuki Maezono, and Yuma Shichiri, along with a female underclassman from an affiliated school named Marino Tagaya; Koichiro becomes friends with them. Since the school used to only have female students, there are certain classes oriented towards girls which are still required to take, such as lessons on love and romance.

447081.overview: Yoshinori Asamiya is a high school freshman who is in the shogi club. One day, he meets a girl while she was walking her dog. She's from a different school, but she's on the shogi club as well... That girl was Ayumi Jinguuji, and Yoshinori can't help but be intrigued about her. Even if at first it was difficult to be her friend, Ayumi seems to have taken a liking to him.

447233.overview: Slotter Up Core 2 - Gouda Minami no Teiou is a Japanese skill-stop slot machine. It is similar to traditional (auto-stop) slot machines, except with Pachislo, the player uses three buttons to stop the reels, which requires some skill. The machine accepts tokens and features an LCD screen, music and extra reels, which enhances the standard reel play. The spin knob on a Pachislo machine is located on the front of the cabinet instead of a handle on the side on a traditional slot machine.

447352.overview:
Junichi is motorcycling to high school when he gets into an accident and suffers a bout of amnesia. As the game starts, Junichi is in his dorm room and remembers that he has to head for school. As he walks through the town, he passes a stream and stares at the water but his moment of contemplation is broken by a teacher. Heading on to school, Junichi meets a schoolmate who's standing in the hallway and interacts a bit.

When he finally reaches class, the seats are all empty but his teacher joins him in the classroom. Junichi experiences a flashback of a blonde girls and faints to the floor. Afterwards, the intro to the game plays where the gal classmates are shown in slow and deliberate animation. Later, additional students interact with Junichi but he can't remember who they are and what their level of associations are.

447356.overview: Shanghai: Sangoku Pai Tatagi is a puzzle game, developed by Warashi and published by SunSoft, which was released in Japan in 2002.

447404.overview: Simple 2000 Series Ultimate Vol. 22: Stylish Mahjong: Usagi: Yasei no Touhai & Usagi: Yasei no Touhai The Arcade Double is a compilation of two mahjong games "USAGI YASEI NO Touhai (Dramatic Mahjong)" and "USAGI YASEI NO TOPAI - THE ARCADE".

447470.overview: Simple 2000 Series Ultimate Vol. 4: Urawaza Ikasa Mahjonggai: Nii-san, Tsukanjimatta You da ne is a mahjong game that features 2 different game modes, the first one is a story mode in which the player will advance through the story defeating the opponents, the other game mode is a free mode in which the player can play mahjong matches against 3 computer opponents (that are the one that he can unlock in the story mode).

447537.overview: A two-player mahjong game in which you compete with the gravure idol Futaba Riho, a popular character from D3 Publisher, in situations such as sandy beaches, classrooms, schoolyards, swimming pools, and Riho's rooms. When you win, you can get various costumes, and she will show you a punishment game. Photography is also available during the punishment game.

447542.overview: Simple 2000 Ultimate Vol.14 - Topai Dramatic Mahjong is a mahjong game based on a manga that features at the beginning of the game 2 different game modes, the main one is the story mode in which the player will advance through the story winning mahjong matches, the other mode is a sort of a free mode in which the player can play against 3 different computer opponents.

447543.overview: Simple 2000 Ultimate Vol.20 - Love Mahjong 2 is a Mahjong game that takes place in various outdoors environments and involves playing the ancient board game with scantily-clad women. The game features unlockables costumes and pictures galleries.

447544.overview: Chou-Saisoku! Zokusha King BU no BU is a racing game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2005.

447559.overview: K-1 Premium 2005 Dynamite is a fighting game, developed by HuneX and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2005.

447562.overview:
Morinaga Satsuki is the only daughter of a family that owns an antique store, with no special redeeming features she is a extremely normal 2nd year high school student. It's the 24th of August, with one week left in her summer vacation. On the day that her parents leave for a purported business trip she spontaneously by chance finds a sparkling yellow ring, "Chrysoberyl".

When Satsuki took that ring and put it on, the man sealed inside was summoned into this world.
He called himself a demon called "Ruen Egrandin".
He semi-forcefully asked her to help him find the "Thing he was looking for", and as a reward he would grant her a "wish that wasn't particularly a wish".

447567.overview: Simple 2000 Ultimate Series Vol.11 - Wandaba Style - Totsugeki! Mix Ki Juice is a music game with some adventure parts in which the story takes part, but the gameplay in the game are in the 15 songs parts in which the player to advance in the story has to make a good performance.

447844.overview: The player plays as Kyuji, the star ace of the Temjins baseball team. He needs to embark in various training missions to defeat the team's rival, the Black Nines. Players can choose to focus in batting, pitching, or running before playing the big game.

447852.overview: Simple Outlaws DX Gaiden: Chou Saisoku! Zokusha King Bore Up: Butchigiri Densetsu 2 is a racing game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2004.

447874.overview: Sekai Saikyou Ginsei Igo 5 is a board game, published by Magnolia, which was released in Japan in 2004.

447875.overview:
Sangokushi 11: Power Up Kit is an expansion pack for Romance of the Three Kingdoms XI. It adds following features to the base game:

Buildings merging system
Ability researching system
Decisive Battle Dominating Mode, a stage clearing mode
6 new scenarios
30 new historical events
In-game editor
Japanese voice
Extreme difficulty level
New techniques
AI improvement
Other minor improvements and adjustments

447876.overview:
Sangokushi VIII: Power Up Kit is an expansion pack for Romance of the Three Kingdoms VIII. It adds following features to the base game:

Marriage and child rearing system
Tactical Campaign Scenario Mode, a stage clearing mode
3 new scenarios after the death of Zhuge Liang
~60 new officers
In-game editor
Chronology function
AI improvement

447877.overview:
Sangokushi IX: Power Up Kit is an expansion pack for Romance of the Three Kingdoms IX. It adds following features to the base game:* Stage-clearing stories called "Trial Stories"

Players may obtain and train fictional officers at random
AI warlords may merge with another one when they are too weak
AI improvement
An extremely difficult mode named "Expert Mode"
More marching routes available
Each city now has a special defense skill
In-game editor
Chronology function

447878.overview: Sekai Saikyou Ginsei Igo Kouza is a board game, developed and published by SilverStar, which was released in Japan in 2009.

447879.overview: Sekai Saikyou Ginsei Igo 6 is a board game, developed and published by Magnolia, which was released in Japan in 2005.

447880.overview: Sengoku Tenka Touitsu is a strategy game, developed and published by SystemSoft, which was released in Japan in 2009.

447881.overview: Sengoku Hime is an alternative historical simulation game, much in the same style as Nobunaga's Ambition series and the Romance of the Three Kingdoms series by KOEI. It is in fact based on the Tenka Touitsu Advance game engine with some modifications.

447882.overview:
Timeslip!? Kazuto is sent to the other world one night when he is sleeping back in his own world... He wakes to find himself in the Koihime Musou universe.

The adventure continues in this alternate version of the classic Chinese historical novel "Romance of the Three Kingdoms".

447883.overview: A compilation that combines the popular digital novel "Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica" and "Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica: 3 & 4-wa Kanketsu-hen" into one!

447884.overview:
In the continent of Polyphonica, spirits materialize in the world, surviving on the music that is played by humans, and live together with them. While the spirits don't appear often, some spirits have enough power to materialize in human or animal forms and live together with humans.

Dantists, who play special music called "Commandia," are widely respected in this world. They also usually are in contract with powerful spirits. The story of Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica revolves around the new Dantist, Phoron Tatara, the spirit that he made contract with, Corticarte Apa Lagranges, and their friends, in their daily life and work.

447890.overview:
Shine - Kotoba o Tsumuide: One day, the protagonist decided to chase after the dream of becoming a cameraman. To become the student of his famous upperclassman (senpai) cameraman in his university, he headed towards an island in Okinawa area where his upperclassman cameraman lived. On the way to the island, the protagonist met his senpai luckily and was given a very hard assignment to complete. If he complete the assignment, then he could become his senpai's student.

That assignment is taking a picture of all six girls who he met on the ship by chance. And for some reasons, all six girls hate camera. But, there is nothing he can do about it because if he doesn't take their photos, his road to become a cameraman is closed.

447903.overview: This game contains the final two episodes of the story, and is a sequel to and continuation of Shinkyoku Sōkai Polyphonica. Originally released for the PC in single episodes, the first PS2 port was split in two releases, which later got re-released to include all the episodes from 0 to 4. The PlayStation 2 release features CG event graphics not featured in PC version, and now has full voice-acting for all the characters.

447905.overview: Two hundred years ago a great war almost wiped out mankind from the face of the Earth. Survivors of the war decided to start anew and slowly rebuilt the towns while relying on steam trains as a transportation to connect the towns around the globe. Over time, children with inexplicable new powers were born into this world. Afraid of anything they could not explain, people sent all such children to Roddo Town, a town isolated from the rest of the world by a great steel wall. It is also the town the game takes place in.

447907.overview:
The series, set in the Heian era, Abe no Masahiro is the grandson of the great onmyoji, Abe no Seimei. Seimei, who passed his teachings on to his grandson, Masahiro who has lost his sixth sense and the ability to see spirits. Masahiro constantly feels resentful for being in his grandfather's shadow.

Even so, one day, Masahiro meets a fox-like creature which he names Mokkun who shows him his true potential powers after fighting a demon. Mokkun is actually Toda, see Teng (mythology), who prefers to be called Guren. He is one of the twelve shikigami called the Shinsho, who has pledged his loyalty to Seimei and is helping Masahiro to surpass his grandfather.

Masahiro's dream to surpass his grandfather may not be realised easily as not only does he have to convince the other Shinsho that he is Seimei's true successor, he must also increase his power in order to stop demons coming from China, the other parts of Japan and the Underworld as well as rival onmyoji's who want to destroy Japan. He also has to keep his promise to protect Princess Akiko of the Fujiwara clan.

447908.overview: Soon after returning to the present day from an adventure in Heian period Japan, the high school student from the original Shoujo Yoshitsune Den game experiences another trime traveling incident to the past. Reunited with the gal Yoshitsune Minamotono, another adventure starts where the conflict between Genji and Heike is recreated in a storyline that is part historical fact melded with fictional themes. Tactical battles are fought on isometric maps while interactive sequences are played through character dialogue screens where actions trigger responses from the heroines and heroes in the game.

447909.overview:
Shoujo Yoshitsune Den is a WellMade's love simulation, where you are mysteriously whisked away to Heian Era Japan and find yourself meeting people, fighting enemies, and loving women in an adventure RPG.

The battle system in Shoujo Yoshitsuden is a turn-based simulation, featuring a Commentary System, where characters make commentary on the battle situation as the battle progresses. Outside of battle, story and love-simulation elements feature big -- get to know the girls of the village and ask them on dates.

447910.overview:
Shinkyoku Sōkai Polyphonica franchise branched into several different series identified by color. Original series are known as crimson red, while the later series include black and white stories. This game is the only from the black series and setting is the same as in the original crimson red series, featuring two episodes. First episode takes place around the same time as episode 0 of the original series. The Black series feature Managa, a Rusha Police Department detective in a spirit division department, who is also a winged spirit himself, as one of the protagonists.

Initial release also included a bonus soundtrack featuring six tracks.

447911.overview: Shogi World Champion Gekihashi 2 is a board game, published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 2003.

447912.overview:
Originally released for PC (Windows) with the same title on December 2009, the port to PS2 was done about a year later following the port to a PSP couple of months after the PlayStation 2 port. While the original PC game isn't an adult novel, the console and handheld ports still do more than just port the game and include additional content and graphical tweaking to present the game on each of the devices better.

Aside from obvious graphical updates, the new content that was not present in PC release include:

New CG event scenes by Noboru Kannatsuki (神奈 月昇)
Full voice-acting for all characters, not just the lead ones

447913.overview: In the Northern Europe lies a ruin called "The Ship of Time". Inside is imprisoned a dangerous specie called Berserk. But one day, the Berserk solves the riddle of the seal that has kept it imprisoned for so long and breaks free. Aimed to set the world ablaze once again, Berserk is about to confront the girl with the silver wings, a battle maiden Valkyrie. You play a young man, oblivious to the fact that some things from Norse mythology are not just myths, enjoying his school life until one day, you meet the battle maiden Sol Valkyrie and your whole world changes.

447914.overview: Simple 2000 Honkaku Shikou vol.005 - The Kiryoku Kentei is a igo game featuring different difficulty levels (From beginner to advanced) and different game modes (Story mode, free mode, etc). The game also features a complete igo tutorial in japanese.

447915.overview: An alternate world ruled by swords, magic, and monsters where four moons can be seen in the sky. The dark and chaotic twilight of the Age of Tower ended for this world called Stellamund and it entered the prosperous Age of Crown. But the wizards who triggered the great war during the Age of Tower no longer hold the power they used to have, and quietly researched the great magics that were lost, in a magical academy called Grimoire.

447931.overview: This entry in the Sotsugyou series places you in the role of a teacher at Seika Girls Junior High. You'll supervise the growth of five girls over a year-long period, leading them to graduation. You can attempt to earn the affections of 11 assistant teachers, as well as pairs consisting of each student with her mom. When not at class, you're free to visit your students' homes.

447933.overview: Soutenryuu: The Arcade is a puzzle game, published by DigiCube, which was released in Japan in 2003.

447934.overview:
In AD 2045, a group of military cadets, attending the preparatory course of the Central Military Academy, proceeded for training aboard the space station Aries. Within this group of cadets were Ryota Aizawa and his classmates including Sayaka Nagase and Kazuhiko Nitta. The situation went sour when a terrorist group called "Jararacas" took over the station. While the military successfully evacuated the station, Ryota and his group were trapped aboard. Worse still, the boarding assault left most of the military forces dead, effectively leaving the cadets on their own.

An unexpected twist occurs when a mysterious virus was released within the station, gaining control of almost all personnel and turning them into mindless creatures in the process. This forced everyone, friend and foe alike, to find a way out of the station alive.

447935.overview: A group of people goes to an island to shoot an independent movie. While filming, an accident happens and soon they will have to face the mystery about the island. The game features an unlockable gallery and different endings depending of the player choices during the adventure.

447936.overview: Street Mahjong Trans-Asakami 2 is a mahjong game, developed and published by SunSoft, which was released in Japan in 2000.

447937.overview: Rumina’s (Lumina) father has died of some disease and the 2 twins, Edios and Michael have died in battle. One day she goes on some scavenger adventure with Pelmo and opens a Pandora’s box. From there comes out a ghost who takes over Pelmo’s body and tells her that he can revive any people who did not die of natural causes. She doesn’t listen to the full rules of his contract and agrees to revive both Michael and Edios. Unfortunately this causes everyone to forget that she’s the Queen or who she is. Instead Michael becomes King and Rumina finds herself running around the castle hoping for someone to recognize her face.

447938.overview: Hiiro no Kakera, is a Japanese visual novel created by Idea Factory directed at the female market, known as an otome game. The protagonist is a teenage girl who revisits a small village she remembers from her childhood and gets caught up in her family's history and supernatural dangers surrounding it.

447940.overview:
On a world completely different from Earth people have been living in artificial space colonies for a long time. A few colonies have gathered together to assemble a nation, the people call it "St. Folia".

The protagonist Lumina is the princess of the "Shumar" Kingdom that governs St. Folia. The power that once spanned the entirety of St. Folia is fading, The Shumar Kingdom's outlying principalities are in a state where they can't sustain themselves without help. With conflicts over princes successions and wars between different ethnic groups going on all the time the people are exhausted. But Lumina knows nothing of that reality, she is growing up brightly and straightforward.

One day it is decided that Lumina will be engaged to a influential prince, the ruler of "Eburando" Raios. Lumina opposed the one-sided decision of her father and snuck out of the palace. There she learned that the world is completely different than the one she had been taught about up till now and she sustained a great shock. "I want to know the real world. I don't want to be a person who doesn't know anything about important people."

Facing the opposition of her father, Lumina goes on a journey to explore the world. With the company of her childhood friend Ashe the kingdom's best swordsman and the young erudite genius boy Belmo, Lumina's adventure begins.

447942.overview: In order to save your cousin, who's been sucked into a mirror, you decide to jump into the mirror yourself. You find yourself in a strange, beautiful world of fairies. As you work through the game's storyline, you'll take part in interactive conversations. The game includes an "encore mode" which allows you to view previous event scenes and listen to music that you encountered on your adventure.

447943.overview: Motoki Tsukasa is the main character. From a long while back, he liked lying down in this meadow and looking up into the sky. One day, a girl came by. Her name was Aida Nami. She was two years older. From that day, they watched the sky together every once in a while. They became good friends. Eventually, Tsukasa fell in love with Nami. One day, he confessed his feelings to her. They ended up getting together.....

447945.overview: The main hero of the game Kosuke is a third grade high school student that has to find love with one of his classmates. The game got a system of collecting the maximum of love, if the player can get the maximum he will be a professional of love.

447947.overview: Sokudoku Master is an education game, developed and published by Magnolia, which was released in Japan in 2006.

447954.overview: High-school student Sora Hashiba was hospitalized after falling from the fourth floor of the school building. On his first night back in the dormitory, he wakes to find a strange boy addressing him by the name "Yoru". The stranger identifies himself as "Ran" and says he's Sora's new roommate. The next day, Sora's childhood friend and dorm manager, Matsuri Honjou, informs Sora that the other boy, whom Matsuri identifies as Sunao Fujimori or "Nao-kun," is actually another childhood friend of Sora. Sora doesn't remember meeting Sunao before. In fact, Sora can't remember much of anything regarding his past, and the series follows his quest to regain his memory.

447955.overview: Possibly the turning point in the series. Sora and Sunao continue their life in school. All seems normal until Sora notices a child that looks very similar to himself. Also, some of his schoolmates are beginning to act a little strange. Even Sora begins to notice that something odd about his connection to Sunao and the relationship between their alternate personalities Yoru and Ran. Depending on the choices of the player, Sora may end up with Sunao, Matsuri, Soushi, or Minato. Collecting all the CGs allows the player to access secret endings that involve Sora, Sunao, Matsuri, Shin-ichirou, and Nanami banding together as cosplaying bandits 848, 370, 332, 416, and 773.

447956.overview: Super Mic-chan is an action game, published by Pacific Century Cyber Works, which was released in Japan in 2001.

447957.overview: This visual novel is made as a set of four love stories, featuring different characters, which take place in a remote Tokiwa village during summertime. Basic gameplay consists of reading the story with static background images and occasional choices which can take player and a reader toward a different ending. While this is a port from Suika A.S+ for PC, certain elements and texts in the story have been altered. Also, opening and ending cut-scenes have been done anew as well as cut-scenes between chapters.

447958.overview:
The main character (Araki Kazuma) is a high school student. But, he has lost all his memories due to a traffic accident. He doesn't remember anything. All he knows is his Japanese, which at least allows him to speak with the person in front of him, who claims that he is suffering from a strange variation of amnesia, where his basic survival knowledge is kept intact, but his memories are sealed away by a trauma as if he didn’t want to remember it.
Sending him back to the waiting room shows that a person named Aya calls him Ma-kun and tells him about his past, like the fact that his name is Kazuma, and his parents are overseas studying architecture.

447959.overview: Sumomomo Momomo revolves around the life of Koshi Inuzuka, a normal high school student who is aspiring to become a prosecutor after graduating. One day, a strange girl named Momoko Kuzuryu approaches him and informs him that they are betrothed and expected to produce a strong child together, though Koshi does not accept it. The betrothal came about after Koshi's father and Momoko's father both arranged the marriage between their respective kids. After Koshi and Momoko's initial meeting, Koshi realizes that Momoko is not just a normal, though however strange, girl, as she has been trained by her father in a special form of martial arts that only twelve such families in all of Japan are able to possess. These twelve families coincide with the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac, where Momoko is from the family associated with Dragons, while Koshi is from the family associated with Dogs. The Dragon family is the head of the six families of the west, whereas the Dog family is the head of the six families of the east.

447960.overview: The main character is a high school girl trained in classical piano who has just transferred to a new high school, Aobadai Gakuen. On her first day, she gets lost and meets 4 boys there who are secretly practising as a band. She eventually becomes the songwriter for the band, using her classical background to create fresh melodies for the band to build on.

447961.overview:
On a summer afternoon, I woke up in a hospital bed without any recollection of the past. I was suffering from severe amnesia, and the ones who saved me as I trembled with doubt and fear through the night were my friends and my maid, Yuki. Through their kindness, my life began once again. A new life filled with joy and happiness.

However, the nightmare that haunted me ever since I woke up that day continued to torment me. In my dreams was a woman with pure white skin and black hair so lustrous it seemed to fade into the dark night. And within a few weeks, on the night of the Star Festival, I would meet this beautiful girl. Makino Nanami... The girl whom I killed with my arrow each and every night ...

447962.overview: K-1 World Max 2005 is a fighting game, developed and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2005.

447963.overview: Ururun Quest - Koiyuuki is a fully voiced Japanese PS2 videogame classified as an 'Onna no Ko Senyou (Girl-targeted) Love Simulation+RPG' by its developer. It was released in 2005 and marketed as the first 'RPG targeted towards girls'. The player acts as the main character, Ruri, while she adventures around her world with her friends and finding new companions.

447965.overview: Simple 2000 Hello Kitty Vol.1 - Starlight Puzzle is a Hello Kitty themed puzzle game similar to Devil Dice. Though only in presentation, the exploding action elements of Devil Dice or Bombastic are not present here. Available only in Japan. Hello Kitty and friends stack and arrange blocks in an isometrically viewed 7x7 grid.

447967.overview: Simple 2000 Hello Kitty Series Vol. 2 - Minna de Sugoroku is the second sugoroku game based on Hello Kitty characters, the first one was Gotouchi Hello Kitty Sugoroku Monogatari in the Playstation One console. The gameplay is the classic board game with mini puzzle and action diversions, each character has some star movements and when the stars reach 0 the character has to rest, in each board the player has to reach the board's goal first to win the match.

447972.overview: A RPG in which you work together with other girls to push through automatically generated dungeons. The girls have different special moves and stats depending on the clothes they wear!

447983.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.001 - The Table Board that features different games: Mahjong, Igo, Go, Reversi, Hanafuda, card games, etc. The game also features another mode in which the player controls the boy that have to rescue the girl from a fantasy kindgom playing all the different games through the game (mahjongs, igo, go, reversi, hanafudas, etc) in the different places of that kingdom.

447984.overview: The Pro Yakyuu: 2003 Pennant Race is a baseball game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2003.

447985.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.004 - The Double Mahjong Puzzle is a puzzle game with 2 different kind of puzzles based on mahjong. In both games there is a time limit and when is reaches zero is game over.
- Gekitoride: Here the goal is to put together mahjong pieces of the same kind and make them dissapear. In this mode there are 2 different modes (Arcade & Infinity).
- Space: This time the game is in 3d, the goal is to clear the cube joining 3 mahjong pieces taken from the cube (Arcade & Border).

447986.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.009 - The Renai Adventure - Bittersweet Fools is a visual novel eroge developed by Minori. It was ported to the Dreamcast and PlayStation 2 with H-content removed as part of the Simple series line of "renai adventure" games. It is vol.1 on the Dreamcast and vol.9 on the PS2. The anime opening of the game was directed by Makoto Shinkai. The game takes place in Florence, Italy. The character design is by Yu Aida, whose Gunslinger Girl series also takes place in Italy.

447987.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.012 - The Quiz 20000 Mon is a quiz game with these game modes:
- Quiz Mode: Choose a character and depending of the character the quiz genders will be different. This mode is for 1 player only.
- Challenge Mode: Up to 4 players can play at the same time. Same as the Quiz Mode, depending of the character the questions will be different.
- Quiz Version DX Mode: A board game in which if the player answer the questions in a right way he will win each square of the board. In this mode up to 4 players can play at the same time.

447988.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.013 - The Renai Adventure 2 - Garasu No Mori: Glass no Mori, full title The Renai Adventure ~Garasu no Mori~ (The Love Adventure ~Forest of Glass~) is a PS2 otome game developed by HuneX and published by D3. The game is volume 13 of the Simple Series line of budget games. The game tells the story of the protagonist's last visit to her deceased grandfather's house on the edge of a haunted forest in the countryside. The forest is rumoured to be a 'kamikakushi' that steals away children.

447989.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.015 - The Rugby is a simulation game that puts the player in the role of a high school rugby coach, he (with the help of his staff team members) can decide the teams members and each week trainings to make the best possible team and win the matches and tournaments.

447990.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.017 - The Suiri Aratanaru 20 no Jikenbo is the Sequel to Simple 1500 Series Vol. 59: The Suiri, this detective graphical adventure is part of D3's budget Simple 2000 line.

The gameplay is exactly the same as the first game: Player becomes a detective that have to unravel the mystery of incidents and each story adventure game. The game is divided into 20 episodes. Play time is 5 to 15 minutes for each story. The gameplay is collects the tips by clicking on the screen and after that answer the questions. The bigger differences between this game and the previous one are the best resolution graphics and the character voice acting.

447991.overview:
It's a summer night and school shouldn't be where you're at but there you are with five lovely classmates. It's a group study session but an strange occurrence plunges the school underground and traps you and cohorts inside the storied halls of learning. Use the resources of your classmates and your own knowledge to find a way out of the school and return to your plain-Jane life.

All this would be fine and simple were it not for the strange creatures now roaming the halls. Even though monsters are afoot, love may blossom between you and one of your classmates during the time of strife and love horror.

447992.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.029 - The Renai Board Game Seishun 18 Radio: Youth 18 Radio is a board game that also incorporates slight adventure aspects and high-production anime movies with the completion of each scenario.

447993.overview: Taiyou Suna is famous as an actor as well as a singer. However, his previous scandals are still known to everyone. The characters take advantage of this to increase the ratings on your TV show. However, after the truth is revealed, the TV men go out of their way to help him.

447997.overview:
Simple 2000 Series vol.43 - The Saiban: Shinmaishihoukan Momodashi no 10 no Saiban File is the 43rd installment in D3's ongoing Simple 2000 budget series of games. You slip into the role of a junior lawyer and try to solve 10 different scenarios, which all work together to set up a twisting detective story and court drama. Gameplay involves understanding and convincing the jurors, using diplomacy and all the tools of the trade to win the case.

20XX year, by the revision of the judicial system, the jury system have been introduced in Japan's trial. The main here, Momota Tsukasa got a part-time job for a law firm. With the help of a legal research software and a secretary she will have to try to solve the different cases gaining the jury favours.

447998.overview: The region of Lordenias has seen a peaceful era for the last 400 years thanks to a single hero. However, this time was coming to an end. The king of Magura who controls the south-east island "Sylvania" was fascinated by demons and planned to revive the god of evil. Demons began to appear all over the island and soon the people began to disappear. The demonic forces turn their gaze towards Mid Earth. You will play as the protagonist and go on an adventure to save the world that has fallen. Travel around the world listening to people and gathering information. Around 100 kinds of monster, 50 kinds of magic, and 40 kinds of weapons and protective gear are available in this game.

448014.overview: A game for all people who love to learn Kanji. This game can be easily suggested for anyone wanting to improve their Kanji skills and features modes that let you do it the fun way instead of turning to your boring textbook. There is even a vs. mode to test your Kanji knowledge against a friend!

448016.overview: A baseball game for PlayStation 2, released as part of the Simple 2000 series in Japan.

448018.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 58: The Gekai is a medical adventure game for PlayStation 2 that follows the life of a young surgeon working in the General Surgery Department of Seito University Hospital. The story begins when the protagonist is suddenly assigned to operate on a patient suffering from acute appendicitis, who turns out to be the case of a close colleague. As professional conflicts, ambition, and betrayal begin to surface within the surgical department, the protagonist must confront the question of what it truly means to be a doctor.

Gameplay combines visual novel storytelling with interactive surgical simulations. Players take direct control during thirteen different operations, including appendectomies and esophageal cancer resections, each based on real medical procedures. Every surgery must be completed under pressure, with limited time and the patient’s condition constantly at risk.

Successful operations improve the surgeon’s skill level and unlock special abilities. The story branches based on the player’s decisions and surgical performance, leading to eight unique scenarios and six possible endings. Through these choices, the game challenges players to balance ambition, morality, and compassion in the high-stakes world of modern surgery.

448019.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.067 - The Suiri - Soshite Daremo Inakunatta is the Sequel to Simple 2000 Series Vol. 17: The Suiri Aratanaru 20 no Jikenbo, this detective graphical adventure is part of D3's budget Simple 2000 line.

The gameplay is exactly the same as the first game: Player becomes a detective that have to unravel the mystery of incidents and each story adventure game. The game is divided into 20 episodes. Play time is 5 to 15 minutes for each story. The gameplay is collects the tips by clicking on the screen and after that answer the questions. The bigger differences between this game and the previous one are the best resolution graphics and the character voice acting.

448020.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.066 - The Party Unou Quiz is a brain building game which exercises minds with visual puzzles designed to delight and tease right-brain functions. According to experiments by Nobel Prize winner Roger Sperry, the right brain handles visual clues, symbols, and grasps the big picture.

448021.overview: Simple 2000 Vol.069 - The Board Game Collection: Originally released as European Game Collection, this game is a collection of 5 different board games: Midnight Party, Geister, Zirkus Flohcati, Cartagena & Ursuppe.

448023.overview: The Tokudane is a board game, developed by Tomcat System and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2005.

448025.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 76 - The Hanasou Eigo no Tabi is an educational quiz game in which the player is a japanese tourist (there is the choice to be a boy or a girl at the beginning of the game) that travels to the United States for the first time. In the game the player is supposed to stay for a week in a certain town, in which he will have to communicate in English with the town people and that will deep the friendship while puzzled about cross-cultural questions and memories.

All conversation are in English of course. The game features recorded conversation from various patterns that are from simple English to a bit more complicated English. It is possible to try many times to answer even if you fail. In addition, the correct translation can be viewed, to learn English at their player's own pace.

448062.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol. 92: The Noroi no Game is a game that merges live-action horror movies with horror sound novels, this game promises to deliver a frightening experience. You'll have to solve puzzles to avoid the fears that haunt you and work your way to a good ending.

The plot is about that different people are receiving the game and one after another died after playing it, so the player has to solve the curse and try to reach the good ending.

448070.overview: This entry in D3's Simple series of budget titles is set up like a television quiz show, with over 1000 questions included. In addition to a couple of single player quiz modes, the game lets up to eight players get together for multiplayer play using the multitap. The game includes four unique types of quizzes.

448071.overview:
Simple 2000 Series Vol.086 - The Menkyou Shutoku Simulation is a simulation game about getting a driving license. the game features over 3000 different questions, the game features over his previous version (Simple 2000 Series Vol.25 - The Menkyo Shutoku Simulation) the traffic laws updates of the year 2005. The game features ordinary car license, ordinary motorcycle license, limited ordinary motorcycle license & moped license.

The game is divided into 2 different parts, the test parts in which the player have to answer different questions and go to past the different exams, and the driving part in which the player drives the car in the practices (and after getting the licenses in the town) in a top down perspective.

448072.overview:
A racing themed love/relationship simulation game, Darling Special Backlash: Ai no Exhaust Heat (the steamy subtitle translates to Exhaust Heat of Love) follows the exploits of a team of young male drivers, who compete for the racing group Team Angstrom.

Since the (unseen) main character is a girl with the customizable name of Hitomi, gameplay consists of conversations with said male drivers like Kei Kakami, Arthur Kouka Nagazawa, and Hayato Takashima. Conversations lead to specific events and story twists, which in turn, lead to different types of endings. Will you find happiness?

The original release was available in two different versions, a standard one and a box set with an additional music CD.

448075.overview: The Hanasou Kankokugo no Tabi is an educational quiz game in which the player travels to Korea.

448076.overview: Strap on the Birkenstocks, jostle into the hemp shorts, and wander into the wilderness in search of bugs. As the story goes, a whole mess of insects have escaped from a laboratory. Gone. The hapless scientist at the lab charges the player with the task of finding the same bugs that fit the lab's specimen needs. The setting of the game takes place during summer vacation and the player adopts the persona of a boy with a fascination for insects. A rascally blue-haired girl plays the part of a rival that is also collecting specimens for the lab and barging in on your action.

448077.overview:
Ken Kusakabe, a student at a technical college in Shonan, was spending his days without any purpose. His childhood friend Ai Ito asks him to join the robot research club, which is on the verge of being discontinued.

At first, Ken treats her coldly, but when he learns of the existence of the idol "Asuka Kurimiya" in the robot battle world, he then agrees to join.

448078.overview: In Kimagure Strawberry Cafe you play as Ichigo Mizuhara (default name) and your luck left you when your parents suddenly decide to have a trip for a whole year. Things couldn't get any worse, now you are in charge of a cafe that your parents left you. Well things aren't so bad when you have a childhood friend and your cute underclassmen to help you run the cafe. And who say lady luck just left you, when now suddenly you are stranded to manage the cafe with 5 cute guys.

448080.overview:
The Oneechanbara 2 is a full sequel to the first Oneechanbara game and is the third one in the series.

Of the four PlayStation 2 games of the Oneechanbara "Simple 2000" franchise made, this is the only one that did not receive a European release.

After having finally defeated her younger sister Saki but refraining from mortally wounding her, Aya takes her to the hospital only to discover her missing after Saki had suffered a strange "fever". In trying to find her, Aya encounters the mysterious motorcycle helmet-wearing Reiko trying to murder Saki; after stopping her, Aya uncovers a sinister plot.

448081.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol.093 - The Unou Drill: Also released in PSP. Brain training hits the PS2. Based off Kodama Mitsuo's Right Brain Drill program, the game includes ten drill types as well as an IQ test. The game features 3 different difficulty levels: beginner, intermediate & advanced.

448083.overview: The 85th volume of D3's Simple 2000 series is a quiz game featuring questions from 22 years of anime, totaling over 23 productions. The game includes over 5000 questions from such properties as Peter Pan no Bouken, Romeo no Aoi Sora, Trap Ikka Monogatari, and Flanders no Inu. Gameplay modes include Memorial Quiz, where you select from 8 works and answer questions set in multiple stages that follow the production's storyline, Solo Quiz, where you select from 8 works and 6 genres and work to keep a life meter from reaching zero, and Travel Quiz in which two players answer questions pulled from eight productions simultaneously. The game includes summaries of the original works which provide hints to performing well in the question sessions.

448085.overview: An action shooter with a variety of missions and stories that branch out depending on battle results and choices.

448088.overview: The Taxi 2 is a Racing game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2006.

448089.overview: The Toubou Prisoner is a sandbox game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2006.

448094.overview: A room sharing simulator! Aiming to pass the university entrance exam, you spend one year sharing a room. Freely lay out more than 200 types of furniture and create a variety of environments to simulate a warm and relaxing communal life. If certain conditions are met, gravure idols and charismatic hosts will appear and you can live with them.

448105.overview: The Ochimusha - Doemu Samurai Toujou is an action game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

448109.overview: A racing game developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher. The story is set in the year 2050 A.D. on a highway in a world destroyed by a nuclear war.

448111.overview: The Zerosen is a flight simulation game, developed by Mobile & Gamestudio and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

448125.overview: Simple 2000 Series Vol. 120: Saigo no Nippon Hei: Utsukushiki Kokudo Dakkan Sakusen is an action game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

448128.overview: The Survival Game 2 is a first-person shooter game, developed by Best Media and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2007.

448130.overview: NumCro is a puzzle game, developed by Nikoli and published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

448133.overview: Tokyo Bus Guide 2 is a Japan-only Bus Driving simulator released for the PlayStation 2 in 2005. In this game, you drive a bus on a route through Tokyo, picking up and letting off passengers at the bus stops. The Tokyo Bus Guide series is similar to Crazy Taxi, as they both involve carrying passengers through the city, but unlike Crazy Taxi, Tokyo Bus Guide strictly requires you to follow all of the rules of the road, right down to using your turn signal when changing lanes.

448136.overview: SuperLite 2000 Vol. 2: Shougi is a shogi game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

448137.overview: Othello is a board game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

448139.overview: Crossword is a puzzle game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2004.

448144.overview: Sudoku is a puzzle game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

448146.overview: Oekaki Puzzle is a puzzle game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2003.

448155.overview: When a female co-worker commits suicide, it's up to you to find out what really happened. Talk to fellow co-workers to put the pieces of the puzzle together.

448161.overview: A compilation of three games from the popular detective adventure game "Konohana".

448172.overview: UNO Game is a card game, published by Success, which was released in Japan in 2004.

448202.overview: A game that allows you to experience games such as Chō-han and Cee-lo with a unique sense of tension and bargaining. Includes 10 different types of games.

448245.overview:
Murasaki no Honoo: The game tells the story of the young heir that was studying in the United Kingdom and have to return home to take care of his inheritance as the owner of the Takatsukasa Heavy Industries. The game as usual in this kind of visual novels features different endings depending of the player choices during the game. As a curious feature the game also allows "Tarot divination" in one day if certain conditions are met.

The Limited Edition features a bonus CD.

448807.overview: Simple 2000 Series Ultimate Vol. 9: Bakusou! Manhattan - Runabout 3 - Neo Age (ＳＩＭＰＬＥ２０００シリーズ　アルティメット　Ｖｏｌ．９　爆走！　マンハッタン　～ＲＵＮＡＢＯＵＴ３　ｎｅｏＡＧＥ～) is a Driving/Racing video game published by D3Publisher released on August 14th, 2003 for the PlayStation 2.

463224.overview: The game's plot centers around infamous attorney Jack Thompson moving to South Park, and starting a campaign to ban video games from the town after Cartman accidentally kills Kenny while trying to imitate a mission from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.

463237.overview: A Beat 'em Up based on the hit adult comedy movie South Park: Bigger, Longer, and Uncut! Fight enemy's, protect Terrance and Phillip from danger!

463253.overview: The cancelled South Park game from 2005! Play as Cartman as he escapes the insane isylum with the use of his reactivated V-Chip

467586.overview: Lead the Western Army to victory in this decisive war! In order to defeat the commander-in-chief, Tokugawa Ieyasu, you must slash through a horde of enemy soldiers that fill the screen in this thrilling swordplay action game. There are seven stages in total. Use the "Lock-on System" to lock onto a horde of enemies and unleash your special move, the "Lightning Consecutive Attack," to slash them down one after the other!

471641.overview: A classic and nostalgic collection for PlayStation 2, very popular in Brazil, which brings together emulators of old consoles in a single DVD. Includes Atari 2600, NES (Nintendo), Super Nintendo, Master System and Mega Drive games, ideal for offline entertainmentular in Brazil, which brings together emulators of old consoles in a single DVD. Inclui jogos de Atari 2600, NES (Nintendinho), Super Nintendo, Master System e Mega Drive, ideal para entretenimento offline

480016.overview: This Emulator has allowed to play Super Nintendo Games for Sony PlayStation 2.
